tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bya ba'i

rgyud mtha' dag la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bya ba'i rgyud mtha' dag la 'jug pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag rig pa bla med 'gro rnams la/ /mchog stsol bde gshegs kun gyi snying po de/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro bas myur du grub slad du/ /dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal la phyag bgyi'o/ /'dir sdom ni/ dam rgya bcing dang phyag 'tshal bdag nyid 'bul/ /sems bskyed bgegs srung byin rlabs rnam dag bsgom/ /bdun po de rnams rang rgyud sbyang ba yin/ /phyi yi 'khrus dang bsrung ba khrus chu sgrub/ / bsangs gtor khrus sa byin rlabs byug pa bya/ /lus sogs bkru dang gnas su 'jug pa ste/ / brgyad po khrus kyi cho ga yin par shes/ /bdag srung mchod pa'i bgegs bsal gzi byin bskyed/ / mchod pa byin rlabs phur bu gdab pa dang*/ /phyogs bcing ba la rim pa gsum yod cing*/ /drwa gur mtshams gcod don tshan bcu po ni/ /bgegs rnams bsal ba'i sde tshan nyid du gtogs/ /rgyud sbyang ba dang khrus bya bgegs bsal ba/ /sde tshan gsum po 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro yin/ /rnal 'byor 'jug pa'i bya ba drug yin te/ /'bags pa bsal dang gtan la 'dug pa dang*/ /rdo rje len dang gdu bu gdags pa dang*/ /bsad byed bzung dang ze'u kha bcing ba'o/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga'ang rnam pa drug yod de/ /bdag gi de nyid rten bskyed spyan drangs dang*/ /bzhugs gsol dam bzhag tshogs bsags de la brgyad/ /mchod pa bstod pa bshags pa skyabs 'gro dang*/ /gsol gdab sems bskyed tshad med bzlas pa'o/ /slar btang ba dang thun mtshams rnal 'byor gnyis/ /'jug chog yin te thun mtshams rwa ba bkrol/ /glaigs bam bklag dang rjes dran drug sgom dang*/ /maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing sā' tswa gdab pa sogs/ /snod gos bkru ba'am sngags pa'am bsangs gtor bya/

/bsrungaskud bya zhing bza' min zos pa sbyangs/ /slar btang man chad rjes kyi bya bar bsdu/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi cho ga rgyas pa la/ /bsnyen pa'i rim pa de ltar yin par shes/ /de ltar sdoms su bsgrigs pa'i don cung zad phye ste bshad na/ bya ba'i rgyud las byung ba bsnyen pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rim pa la/ rnal 'byor gyi yan lag bzhi ste/ rnal 'byor gyi sngon du bya ba'i rim pa/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i bya ba/ rnal 'byor dngos gzhi'i nyams len/ rnal 'byor rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la rgyud sbyang ba/ khrus bya ba/ bgegs gsal ba gsum mo/ /de'i dang po la/ dam tshig gi sngags rgya bcing ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ bdag nyid 'bul ba/ sems bskyed pa/ bgegs srung ba/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ rnam dag stong nyid sgom pa ste bdun no/ /gnyis pa khrus kyi bya ba la/ phyi'i khrus dngos dang*/ khrus kyi srung ba dang*/ khrus chu sgrub pa dang*/ bsangs gtor dang*/ sa khrus kyi sa byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ byug pa sa'i khrus dang*/ lus dang gdong dang lag pa bkru ba dang*/ lha'i gnas su 'jug pa ste brgyad do/ /gsum pa bgegs bsal ba la/ bdag srung ba/ mchod pa srung ba/ gnas srung ba gsum/ de'i gnyis pa mchod pa srung ba la/ mchod pa'i bgegs bsal/ mchod pa gzi byin bskyed/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs pa gsum/ gsum pa gnas srung ba la/ phur bu gdab pa dang*/ steng phyogs bcing ba dang*/ 'khor yig bcing ba dang*/ rwa ba bcing ba dang*/ rā gur phub pa dang*/ mtshams gcod pa ste rim pa drug go / gnyis pa rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i bya ba drug ste/ 'bags pa bsal ba/ gdan la 'dug pa/ dam tshig rdo rje len zhing bcing ba/ gdu bu gdags pa/ bsangs byed bzung ba/ ze'u kha bcing ba'o/ gsum pa rnal 'byor dngos gzhi'i nyams len la/ bdag gi de kho na nyid sgom pa dang*/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs pa dang*/

bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ dam la gzhag pa dang*/ tshogs bsags pa'o/ drug pa tshogs bsags de la dbye na/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ bshags pa/ skyabs 'gro/ gsol gdab/ sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi/ sngags bzlas pa ste brgyad do/ /rnal 'byor rjes kyi rim pa la/ slar btang ba dang*/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba gnyis so/ /de ltar na sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi sde tshan rnams nges par bya'o/ /de la dang po kho na nas gtsang sbra dang bcas te bod rnams lag len mdzad pa ltar na/ sdoms su ma 'dus kyang thog ma nyid du spyi dang mtshungs par skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa bya/ khyim pa yin na bsnyen gnas kyi gso sbyong don zhags kyi cho ga ltar blang*/ de nas cho ga'i rim pa rnams phreng chags su bgrangs na 'di lta ste/ 1 dam tshig gi sngags rgya bcing ba/ 2 phyag 'tshal ba/ 3 bdag nyid 'bul ba/ 4 sems bskyed pa/ 5 bgegs srung ba/ 6 byin gyis rlabs pa/ 7 rnam dag sgom pa/ 8 phyi khrus bya ba/ 9 khrus kyi srung ba/ 10 bsangs chu sgrub pa/ 11 bsangs gtor bya ba/ 12 sa byin rlabs/ 13 sas byug pa/ 14 lus sogs bkru ba/ 15 gnas su 'jug pa/ 16 bdag srung ba/ 17 mchod pa'i bgegs bsal ba/ 18 gzi byin bskyed pa/ 19 mchod pa byin rlabs/ 20 phur bus gdab pa/ 21 steng phyogs bcing ba/ 22 khor yug bcing ba/ 23 rwa ba bcing ba/ 24 gur 'bugs pa/ 25 mtshams gcod pa/ 26 'bags pa bsal ba/ 27 gdan la 'dug pa/ 28 rdo rje bcing ba/ 29 gdu bu gdags pa/ 30 bsang byed bzung ba/ 31 ze'u kha bcing pa/ 32 bdag gi de nyid/ 33 rten bskyed pa/ 34 lha spyan drangs pa/ 35 bzhugs su gsol ba/ 36 dam la bzhag pa/ 37 mchod pa/ 38 bstod pa/ 39 bshags pa/ 40 skyabs 'gro 41 / gsol gdab/ 42 sems bskyed/ 43 tshad med bzhi/ 44 bzlas brjod byed pa/ 45 slar btang ba/ 46 thun mtshams kyi bya ba ste/ don tshan bzhi bcu zhe drug yod pa las/ dang po dam tshig gi sngags dang phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ oṃ tā thā ga ta ud bha we swāhā/

zhes brjod cing*/ thal mo bkan pa las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug pa mgo la bzhag pa ni de bzhin gshegs rigs spyi'i dam rgya'o/ /gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ mgon po thugs rjes che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge ba'i ngan song las grol zhing*/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol bas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ / gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron me rab rgyas shing*/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun gyis brgyan/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol pa/ /rtag par rtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rigs sngags rgyal po dge ba can/ /gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba po/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin dam pa 'grub pa ste/ / rigs sngags 'chang kun dbang phyug rje/ /dpa' bo gcig pu dgra thul ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ /lha dang lha min dri zar bcas/ /klu dang gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mchod/ /thub pa sangs rgyas gnyis par 'dud/ / ces so/ gzhan yang ji ltar 'os pa'i phyag 'tshal ba dag bsnan kyang mi 'gal lo/ kha cig oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra pra ṇa me na/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ban da nāṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag byed de/ bya rgyud rang lugs yin min brtag dgos pas re zhig mi bya'o/ gsum pa bdag nyid 'bul ba ni/ snying gar thal mo sbyar/ bdag ming che ge mo zhes bgyi ba/ chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bdag 'bul bar bgyi'o/

/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des kyang bdag la rnam pa thams cad dang dus thams cad du byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ yongs su bsrung bar gyur cig /bdag la grub pa dang mchog stsol cig / ces rgyud 'di nyid las 'byung ba'am/ spyi 'gro'i tshig gis kyang rung ngo*/ /bzhi pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don sgrub slad du/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gson/ /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir/ / deng nas byang chub sems bskyed do/ /de yan chad kyi sngags dang tshigs cha rnams lan gsum gsum bya'o/ / lnga pa bgegs srung ba ni/ lag pa gnyis sor mo phan tshun bsnol te bsdams pa'i khu tshur rdo rje phyir bsdams su grags pa de byas la/ /mthe chung gnyis gshibs te sgreng*/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar te brkyang ba'i g.yas g.yon du mthe bong gnyis sbyar ba khro bo banol ba med pa'i phyag rgya de/ snying ga dang*/ lkog ma dang*/ smin mtshams dang*/ spyi bo rnams su sngags lan re res gtugs/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha mahā ba la/ ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+wa na sa ya/ u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃ ṣ+to da ka ṭa bhai ra pā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+na bi nā ya kaṃ /mahā ga na pa ti/ /dzi bi ta an+ta ka rā ya swāhā/ zhes pa bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas pas kyang ngo*/ drug pa byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsung rigs sngags kyi ngo bo ma yig gser gyi mdog can dang*/ 'tshogs mar khro bo mi g.yo ba'i gsung rigs sngags kyi ngo bo ha yig sngon po 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs par gyur/

bdun pa rnam dag stong nyid sgom pa ni/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad bdag nyid kyi sems su 'dus shing*/ sems rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'o/ /ces brjod cing don bsam/ bsnyen pa'i cho ga bsdus pa la dga' bas de yan chad bor kyang chog go /brgyad pa phyi'i khrus dngos ni/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las gsal mod/ bod pa'i chog khrigs kyi dkyus 'jug stabs mi bde bas/ khrus dang gtor ma'i bya ba sngon rol nas grub par bya ste/ 'dir yid kyis mos pa tsam bya'o/ / rdor bsdams las mdzub mo gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs/ /mthe bong gnyis de'i g.yas g.yon du sbyar la/ oṃ ni kha na ba su dhe swāhā/ lan bdun la sogs pa mang du bzlas te/ sa dang chus bkrus par bsam/ dgu pa khrus kyi srung ba ni/ /mthe bos mthe chung gi sen mo mnan/ sor mo lhag ma gsum rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul du byas/ lag gnyis bsnol nas phyag rgya de dpung pa g.yas g.yon du bzhag /yid tsam aṃ gtsigs bsdams/ khro bo'i lta ba dang bcas pas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bdag nyid srung ngo*/ /'di bdud rtsi'i sngags 'bring po yin no/ /bcu pa bsang chu sgrub pa ni/ snod bzang por chu gtsang ma dri zhim pos sbags pa la dmigs te/ na mo rat+na trā yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ oṃ hūṃ ha na ha na badz+re badz+re ṇa haḥ lan nyer gcig nas brgya'i bar du bzlas/ bcu gcig pa bsang gtor ni/ oṃ kī li kī li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun la sogs pa bzla zhing*/ g.yon pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas bsang chu blangs te bdag dang*/ gnas dang*/ yo byad dang*/ sa'i gong bu la bsangs gtor bya/ bcu gnyis pa sa byin gyis rlabs pa ni/

oṃ badz+ra ha ra hūṃ/ lan bdun no/ /bcu gsum pa sa khrus ni/ oṃ bhu ra dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun las mi nyung ba bzlas te/ lag pa la sas byug cing 'phyis par bya'o/ /bcu bzhi pa lus sogs bkru ba ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ lan nyer gcig tsam yid kyis bzla zhing*/ lus dang gdong dang lag pa rnams 'khrus chus bkru'o/ /'on kyang chog khrigs la yid bzlas kho na mi mngon pas ngag bzlas byed dgos so/ /nyams len bsdud pa'i skabs gong gi phyi khrus dang*/ lus sogs bkru ba 'di kho nas 'grub pas bar gyi rnams bor bas chog go /'dir khrus kyi cho ga 'bring po dkyus su bshad pa 'di nyid de rgyas pa ni gzhan las rtogs par bya'o/ /thob thang la de yan chad sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu byed pa yin/ deng sang gi chog khrigs ltar na de ltar sgrub dka' bas nang du byed pa las 'os med do/ / bco lnga pa gnas su 'jug pa ni/ gos gsar pa gyon/ sgrub khang dang nye bar rkang pa bkrus/ nye reg byas khang par zhugs/ lha rnams mngon sum du dmigs pa la phyag byas nas/ sgo nang du lha la phyogs de 'dug dgos pa yin pa las/ chog khrigs kyis skabs su gzhan de dag dmigs par bya zhing*/ a mṛ ta bzla bzhin du nye reg dngos su byas na legs/ mthar oṃ bi ra dza bi ra dza mahā badz+ri sa ta sa ta sā ra te sā ra te tra ye tra ye/ bidha ma ni sa ma bhañdza ni ta ra ma ti sid+dhi a gre taṃ swāhā/ gnas su zhugs shing dam tshig la 'jug pa'i sngags 'di lan gsum bya/ bcu drug pa bdag srung ba ni/ oṃṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā/ zhes pa de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi las thams cad pa lan nyer gcig dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se nā= zhes pa nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa / gong bzhin bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags 'bring po lan gsum gyis dung chos la sogs pa bsang chu'i snod lag pa g.yon tu bzhag /g.yas pas rang gi lus la gtor ro/

/bcu bdun pa mchod pa'i bgegs bsal ba ni/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags de nyid lan gsum du bzla bzhin du/ mchod pa la mthor yab kyis bsang chu gtor/ yang dzi na dzika zhes pa de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi snying po lan bdun las mi nyung bas kyang mchod pa la bsangs gtor bya'o/ /bco brgyad pa gzi byin bskyed pa ni/ g.yon pa'i gung srin gnyis mthe bos mnan/ mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung gnyis gdub bu'i tshul du gung srin gnyis kyi rgyab tu sbyar/ g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya kha gyen du bstan nas g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub gi 'og nas bton te/ gung mo bzung ba ltar byed pa ni/ gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyag rgya ste/ de nyid mchod pa rnams kyi steng nas/ lding skor dang bram pa'i tshul byed de de la bram pa zhes bya ba ni cab se cab se reg pa'i tshul dang thig gtor gyi tshul byed pa'o// oṃ te dza te dza saṃ sud+dhe sādha swāhā/ lan mang du bzla ste/ 'di de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi gzi byin bskyed pa'o/ /bcu dgu pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ yang gong du bshad par ltar gyi/

na mo rat+na tra yā ya= nas/ ha na ha na a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ kyi bar dang*/ phyag rgya gong bzhin te thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgya lan bdun la sogs pas mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ dzi na dzika lan gsum la sogs pas brtan par bya'o/ / bsdu na mchod pa'i bgegs bsal/ gzi byin bskyed byin rlabs te/ gsum po de dag skabs 'dir ma byas kyang chog go /nyi shu pa phur bus gdab pa ni/ lag pa gnyis ka'i gung srin gnyis gdu bu ltar byas te/ rang rang phyogs kyi spe sha la btsugs/ mthe'u chung mdzub mo gshibs te bsgrengs/ mthe bong rtse sbyar te bsgreng ba las lag mgo'i rgyab nang du phyogs pas rtse mo thur la bstan pa ni phur bu'i phyag rgya ste/ oṃ kī li kī la badz+ri badz+ri bhu ra bhan+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum bzlas pas bgegs thams cad la phur bus btab par bsam/ oṃ kī li kī la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis kyang bsangs gtor bya'o/ /'di phyogs bcing ba'i nang gi 'og phyogs 'ching ba yin kyang*/ bgegs la phur bus 'debs pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa khyad par can gzhan yod pa'i phyir/ phyogs bcing ba'i nang du ma bsdus par phur bus gdab pa zhes don tshan la sogs par byas so/ / nyer gcig pa steng phyogs bcing ba ni/ oṃ su sid+dhi ka ra dzā li ta a nan ta mur ta ye dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces spyi dang*/ oṃ dz+wa la hūṃ/ zhes khyad par gyi sngags lan gsum gyis steng phyogs bcing par 'gyur/ 'di skabs bdug spos spor/ nyer gnyis pa 'khor yug bcing ba ni/ spos chus phyogs mtshams thams cad du gtor la/ dzi na dzi ka mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/ bh+rūṃ/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams dang*/ me la sogs pa'i phyogs mtshams thams cad bcings par gyur/ nyer gsum pa rwa ba bcing ba ni/ sngar gyi phur bu'i phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bong gyen du bstan zhing kha phyai ba ni/

rwa ba'i phyag rgya ste de nyid phyogs mtshams kun tu bstan la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sa ra sa ra badz+ra/ prā ka ra hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje'i rwa ba bar 'tshams med pas phyogs thams cad bskor bar gyur/ nyer bzhi pa gur 'bugs pa ni/ rwa ba'i phyag rgya de nyid kha thur du bstan la steng du bskor ba dra ba'i phyag rgya ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ṣ+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā na ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bi s+phu ra rak+ṣa badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ steng du rdo rje'i gur sra zhing 'thug la rtse mo mthon po grub par gyur/ 'di dag gi skabs su gur dang dra ba don gcig par byed do/ /nyer lnga pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ oṃ kī li kī la badz+ri badz+ri bhu ra ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gyis srung 'khor rnams byin gyis rlabs par mos shing*/ mthe bos sor mo rnams mnan pa'i khu tshur bcings la/ sdigs 'dzub brkyang ste/ dbus na rgya je che je cher lan gsum du bskor zhing*/ na maḥs man+ta badz+ra ṇāṃ/ oṃ ta ra ta ra/ tu ru tu ru/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ra sa si me sa sam+ban+dha ku ru ku ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa man+ta badz+re sa man+ta badz+re/ ku ru a ma le ka ru ṇa ma ye/ tu ta ye tu ta ye/ ba ra ba ra/ ka ra ka ra/ su mi ma sa man+ta/ bi dh+wa na sa ya/ dz+wa la ya swāhā/ lan gsum/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyi rol du me dpung 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ rgyun gyi nyams len sngon 'gro bsdus pa'i skabs/ phur gdab dang bsangs gtor dang mtshams gcod pa'i sngags rgya gnyis pa tsam gyis kyang chog pa'i skabs yod do/ / nyer drug pa 'bags pa bsal ba ni/ /spos chu lag mthil du blug la/ dzi na dzika mang du bzlas te/ rang gi spyi bo nas bsangs gtor bya/ /nyer bdun pa gtan la 'dug pa ni/ rtsa ku sha'i gdan sogs la 'dug par mos te/ na mo rat+na=

nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ gyi bar bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bzla bzhin du/ gtan la bsangs gtor byas te/ skyil mo krung gis 'dug go/de yan chad gtan gzhan la gnas pa'am 'greng stai bya ba yin la/ /phyis sgom bzlas byed sa'i gtan la 'dug pa'i mtshams ni 'di'o/ /nyer brgyad pa rdo rje bcing ba ni/ spyi rgyud legs grub las thog phab pa'i shing ngam/ dur khrod gyi 'gal dum las bcos pa'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa tsan+dan dmar pos bskus pa dgos par bshad pa las rtse gsum pa yang phyogs gcig gam phyogs gnyis yin gyi gsal kha med pas/ gnyis ka rung bar mngon la/ 'di kho nar ni ma nges te/ dpung bzang las rdo rje'i rnam grangs du ma gsungs pa bzhin/ gang skabs su bab pa zhig blangs te/ bkrus shing sbyangs/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar gyi brabs/ lag tu blangs te snying gar gtad la/ oṃ dhu na badz+ra ha/ zhes bdun la sogs pa mang du bzlas te/ bdag gi las thams cad mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ dkyus su de tsam gyis chog la/ thog ma'i rdo rje rab tu gnas pa la/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ zhes sogs kyis khro bo legs grub spyan drangs te/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das= sogs dang*/ mchod pa lnga 'bul/ legs grub kyi sngags sam/ oṃ dhu na badz+ra ha/ lan stong la sogs pa bzla/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ 'di dag tu bzhugs te bdag gi las thams cad mdzad du gsol/ zhes byin gyis rlabs pa'i dgongs pa zhu'o/ /'di la sngags bzla ba'i tshe rdo rje de khro bo legs grub kyi phyag tu bzung pa'am/ sku'i mdun du bzhag nas byin gyis rlabs par mos pa yin la/ mthar rdo rje khro bos rang la stsal bar bsam/ de nas mchod yon phul te khro bo gshegs su gsol/ kha cig khro bo rdo rje la thim par bsam nas/ gshegs gsol mi byed pa ni/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi tshul las 'das pa'o/ / nyer dgu pa gdub bu gdags pa ni/

snga rol nas ras skud gtsang ma sum sgril mdud pa gsum bor ba la/ bu to tsi'i 'bru gcig brgyus pa'i lag gdub spyan ma'i sngags lan brgya bzlas pas byin gyis rlabs pa de skabs 'dir g.yas kyi 'khrigs ma la skon te/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ne swāhā/ lan bdun/ oṃ ku lan+dha rī ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun la sogs pas bsngags te/ 'dis ni bgegs kyis mi rdzi ba dang*/ dngos grub myur ba dang*/ gtsang byed du bshad do/ /sum bcu pa bsang byed bzung ba ni/ ku sha'am ma rnyed na/ dge zhing bkra shis pa'i rtswa sngon po srin lag la bcings te/ dzi na dzi ka nyer gcig sogs mang du bzla'o/ / so gcig pa ze'u kha bcing ba ni/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhā na at+ma tsi ba ra swāhā/ lan gsum la sogs pa bzlas te ze'u kha bcing pa'o/ /de la ze'u kha ni 'grub na rin po che'am dar ras la sogs pa las bcos pa'i dprog zhu yin la/ gzhan du na thod bcing pa'am dar ras dmar po'am ser po'am dkar po'i gtsug tor gyi gzugs brnyan bcings kyang rung*/ skra ring po can yin na skra nyid thor tshugs su bcing ba'am/ gtsug phud can gyi gtsug phud 'ching ba'i/ skra bregs pas ni tha na dar ras dmar ser dkar po phra mo rna ltag tu bcings pas kyang 'grub bo/ /so gnyis pa bdag gi de kho na nyid sgom pa ni/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las bdag gis bsgral te/ chos kyi dbyings byang chub mchog la bdag gis dgod par bya'o/ /phyi rol du snang ba 'di thams cad bag chags kyi stobs las/ nang gi shes pa nyid de ltar snang bar zad kyi/ phyi rol du snang ba ni rdul phra rab tsam yang med do/ /de ltar na khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam ste/ sems de yang dmigs pa med pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes gtsang ba dang*/

bde ba dang rtag pa dang bdag dam pa'i pha rol du phyin pa sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' yas pas nye bar brgyan pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing de'i don ring du bsam par bya'o/ / skabs 'di dag tu ches che ba mang po dag kyang rnam 'jom kyi 'grel par lung drangs pa'i lha drug ston byed kyi tshig dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud dang*/ sangs rgyas gsang ba sogs kyis bshad pa la brten nas/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed dgos tshul byed cing tshad ldan yin min la mi lta bar lung rnyed tshad 'dren la/ rigs pa yang dag gis ma lang bar ltar snang gi dmag dpung mang po sbron par byed mod kyi/ khas slangs skyo ma snga btsan thal ches pa kho na las don dang ldan pa ma yin te/ bsam gtan phyi ma rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi rgyud phyi ma yin par bshad kyang*/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi rgyud de bya rgyud yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med cing*/ bod na de'i rtsa rgyud dngos su yang med pas gtsug tor gyi rgyud phyi ma yin pa ci gzhan ngor rtsod pa'i skabs su rgyu mtshan du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ nges par na bsam gtan phyi ma ni spyod rgyud yin te/ don 'di la rnam snang mngon byang dang 'chad tshul gcig kho nar yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam 'joms kyi 'grel par drangs pa'i lung de yang da gdod brtag dgos pa yin gyi da lta ngom du rung ba'i lung ma yin la/ sangs rgyas gsang ba rgyud sde bzhi'i grangs nges dbye ba mi mdzad cing*/ rgyud tshig dngos bstan la bdag bskyed ston mi ston gnyis yod kyang*/ gdul bya'i blo tshod dang bstun nas gcig gis gcig shos la kha 'gengs rgyu yin zhes bya spyod gnyis rgyud sde gcig tu 'dod pa'i lugs de dang*/ rgyud sde bzhir phye nas bya spyod so sor 'dod pa'i lugs de nam yang mi 'grig pas/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa rnams skabs 'dir lung khungs su mi 'gyur ro/ /mdor na bya rgyud yin nges rnams nas/

bdag bskyed zur tsam yang ma gsungs la/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa la ye shes pa bsre ba'i cho ga sogs kyang ye ma bstan zhing*/ der ma zad lung khungs kyi gtso bo 'da' bar mi rung ba'i nges pa can ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ bya rgyud la bdag bskyed ye med par gsungs pa 'di bya rgyud rang skad du bdag bskyed med par 'dod pa la bsgrub byed bla na med pa dang*/ yod par 'dod pa rnams la bzlog tu med pa'i gnod byed stobs chen po ste re zhig 'di ni lung gi sgo nas so/ / rig pa'i sgo nas kyang bya rgyud rang skad la bdag bskyed yod cing*/ bdag bskyed kyi lha drug dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma nas bshad pa'i bzlas brjod dang bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor de dag yod na ni/ bya spyod gnyis kyi mtho dma'i dbye ba la kha bshad kyi spros pa ji tsam mkhas kyang nyams len gyi skabs su mchog dman dang bzang ngan gyi dbye ba cung zad kyang med par thal bar 'gyur zhing*/ de yang 'dod na rgyud sde bzhi dang lnga dang drug la sogs pa'i dbye ba byed pa bzhad gad kyis gnas su 'gyur ro/ /'phros pas chog go /so gsum pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal lam 'bras bris sku bzhugs pa'i gnas la nye bar dmigs nas 'di skad ces brjod de/ yang dag pa'i smon lam stobs las sa phyogs 'dir rin po che du ma las grub pa'i zhing khams sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba gser gyi bye mas brdal bar gyur/ oṃ a tsa la bī ra hūṃ swāhā/ de'i dbus su 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po nya lcibs la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral ba/ pad+ma dang ut+pal la sogs pa'i me tog gis brgyan pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i nya dang 'dabs chags la sogs pa sna tshogs pas gang bar gyur/ oṃ bi ma la dha hā hūṃ/ de'i dbus su ri rab ri'i rgyal po gru bzhi pa/ /ngos bzhin nas gser dang dngul dang*/ in+d+ra nī la dang*/

pad+ma rā ga dang bcas pa'i bang rim gyis brgyan pa/ /tha ma mtha' dag tu dpag bsam gyi shing legs par bskrun pa/ ri rab de'i steng du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang rdo rje 'dzin thams cad nye bar 'du ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad lhag par dgyes pas rnam par rol pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba/ gzhal med khang rdo rje rin po che'i rtse mo mthon po can/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis brgyas pa/ bkra ba blta na sdug pa shin tu rnam par phye ba rin po che'i them skas bzhi dang bcas pa'i nang gi dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po rin po che du mas brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i 'dab ma can/ gser gyi ze ba dang pu sha ra ga'i ze'u 'brus brgyan pa/ snying po'i thog la dngul gyi ri mos bskor ba/ dpag tshad du ma'i khyon can/ ri rab kyi dbus brdol nas byung ba'i ze'u 'bru'i snying por rdo rje 'breng bus gdong nas spras pa'i seng ge'i khri dang de'i steng du pad+ma'i gdan lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdzes pa/ gzhan yang lha rnams kyi gdan dang bcas pa dang*/ steng du rin po che'i bla bre dag kyang skad cig gis byung bar gyur/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje thal mo sor mo g.yas pa steng du yod pa byas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ sarba thā uṅga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum mo/ /so bzhi pa lha spyan drangs pa ni/ snod gtsang mar spos chu gtsang ma me tog dkar po dang bcas pa ni rtsa ba'i mchod yon te/ 'di ni nges par bsham dgos la/ gzhan yang 'grub na/ zhi ba dang dngos grub rab la dza ba'i 'bru dang 'o ma/ rgyas pa dang dngos grub 'bring la til dang zho/ thun mong du 'bras yos so/ /de dag sbyar ba'i mchod yon rtsa ku sha dang bcas pa'ang dgos na de ni logs su bsham pa yin gyi/

spos chu gtsang ma'i steng du de dag ldugs pa ni ma yin no/ /mchod yon de dag spos kyi bdugs/ rigs pa'i rgyal po bh+rūṃ bdun dang*/ rigs kyi snying po dzi na dzika bdun gyis byin gyis rlabs cing*/ oṃ ṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā/ zhes pa de gzhin gshegs rigs kyi las thams cad pa mang nyung ji ltar 'os pas kyang bsngags la/ mchod yon gtsang ma de mdun gyi dbus su bzhag /g.yon du khyad par gyi mchod yon 'bras yos can dang*/ g.yas su bdug spos rnams bshams te/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ zhes lan gsum gyis phyag btsal/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse mo sbyar te bsgrengs/ mthe bong g.yab cing*/ dad pa dang ni dam tshigs gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'dir/ /bdag gi mchod yon 'di bzhes la/ /mchod pas bdag la dges par mdzod/ bh+rūṃ dzi na dzika /shākya mu ne e h+yai hi/ zhes lan gsum la sogs par gsol ba 'debs pas nan tan gyis spyan drangs/ de yang phyag rgya spyi bo'i thad du byas te/ lan dang po phyag rgya kho na bya/ gnyis pa la phyag rgya des mchod yon gtsang ma thogs te spyi bo'i thad nas bzed zhal du 'bul/ gsum pa la rdzas sbyar ba'i mchod yon thog te 'bul/ rdzas rnams dngos su med na/ chu gtsang ngam me tog tsam dang bcas pa 'bul zhing*/ lhag ma dmigs pa kho nas 'grub bo/ /de yang lha bzhengs pa la rang yang 'greng ba dang*/ bzhugs pa la 'dug pa dang*/ gzur ba la gzur bas 'bul bar bshad kyang dngos su ma 'grub na dmigs pas chog go /so lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ de nas pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya kha phye ba'i tshul can gyi/

bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ ka ma la ya swāhā/ yang phyag rgya de dang 'dra ba las/ gung mdzub srin gsum rdo rje rtse lnga lta bur byas la/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ / sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ pad+ma kha phye las/ sor mo dbus ma gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ka hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag rgya gsum po de la ni/ pad+ma'i gdan dang*/ rdo rje'i gdan dang*/ dpa' bo'i gdan zhes grags so/ /de nas/ ye shes dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad so so'i rdzu 'phrul gyi 'byor pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas te nam mkha'i lam las gshegs nas thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal med khang gi chab sgo nas yongs su byon te/ rang rang so so'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni dbus kyi pad+ma chen po'i steng gi rdo rje rin po che'i bzhugs khri la pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog ser po btso ma'i gser gyi lhun po la nyi ma 'bum dus gcig tu shar ba ltar gzi brjid kyi phung po mtha' yas pa rab tu 'bar ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pas 'gro ba thams cad la thar pa'i lam yang dag par ston pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor lta bar mi mngon pa dang smin mtshams mdzod spu dung ltar 'khyil ba la sogs pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yongs su rdzogs pa 'dod chags dang bral ba chen po'i cha byad can sku la na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spro bas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus pa rgyas par 'gengs pa/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sprul pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa 'char ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing lhun gyis grub pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang 'phrin las la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyi khri'i g.yas logs su 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin chen po gser mdog ral pa'i cod pan can na bza' ser po gyon pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje ser po 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ 'di yang na g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa yang rung*/ lcags kyu cig phyag gnyis kar gyis 'dzin par byas kyang chog go /g.yon logs su 'phags ma rdo rje 'dzin ljang khu'am ser mo dong ka'i me tog dang kha dog mtshungs pa'i bla gos can pus mo phyogs gcig gdan la btsugs pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs shing*/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar bas rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ / da lta'i rgyud las/ 'di lha pho yin pa ltar bshad pa ni/ rgya skad du badz+ra dharā zhes pa'i ra yig gi ring cha mo rtags yin yang yig ge nor te ring cha chad pa las bsgyur ba'i skyon yin te/ 'dir lha lnga la de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rigs kyi yum dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ pho nya dang phyag snyan rnams tshang dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di lha mor ma byas na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs kyi yum ma tshang bar 'gyur bas so/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i mdun ngos 'og gi phyogs su khyi'u mtha' med pa/ kho ra kho yug tu me lce 'bar ba a sho ka dmar ba'i me tog rgyas pa lta bu'i mdog can khro zhing 'khrugs la nor bu'i zur phud kyis brgyan pa/ sbrul dkar po'i tshangs skud 'chang ba/

phyag g.yas na gri gug dang*/ g.yon na zhags pa 'dzin zhing*/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa la sogs pa khro bo'i mtshan nyid rdzogs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ / 'di yang na stag lpags kyi smad dkris dang*/ rgyan gzhan rnams kyang sbrul rgyan can du bya'o/ / rdo rje 'dzin ma'i mdun gyi 'og phyogs su bu mo mtha' yas ma zhes bya ba'i pho nya mo gzhon zhu lang tsho can sku mdog / nag mo'am/ ljang khu'am/ sngo sangs pri yaṃ ku'i me tog lta bu dbu skra nag po zur phud gcig pa/ dar sngon po'i gos can phyag na me tog gi 'phreng brgyud thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg pa dang bcas pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la lta ba/ de thams cad kyang rin po che'i dang pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /phyi rol phyogs thams cad du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang lha'i mchog rnams kyis yongs su bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ / so drug pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi'i cho ga la g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe chung mnan pa/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dra ba/ ki li kī la ི'i dam tshig rdo rje bstan te/ shaṃ ka re sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ 'di nyid kyi dgos chos la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dam tshig gi thal mo ni rtsa ba'i phyag rgya ste/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhī satwā nāṃ/ stu sid+dhi sā dha ni a gra kā ru ṇa ba ra re trā yi trā yi ā ti ba le na mo stu ba ra rā yi ghe bh+yo ma hā kre be bh+yaḥswāhā/ zhes pa rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'i sngags kyi gtso bo dang*/ yang spyi 'gro'i cho ga ni/ khu tshur bcings pa gshibs te mthe bong gnyis sbyar te bskyang ba dang*/ dzi na dzika zhes pas 'khor gyi lha pho rnams dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo las mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug /mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs steng mar sbyar/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru= sogs kyis 'khor lha mo rnams dam la bzhag pa ste/

sngags de dag kyang lan gsum nas bdun gyi bar ji ltar 'os pa'o/ /de nas dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha sprad pa las/ gung mo dang mdzub mo rdo rje rtse gsum pa ltar byas/ mthe bong gnyis gung mo'i glo la sbyar ba steng 'og dang phyogs kun tu bskor zhing*/ oṃ ṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ snga na gnas pa dang*/ phyi nas 'brangs pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad cing srung ba chen po byas par gyur/ / so bdun pa mchod pa ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar dzi na dzi ka bsang ba dang*/ oṃ te dza te dza saṃ sid+dhi sā dha ya swāhā/ gzi byin bskyed pa dang*/ na mo rat+na= nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ dzi na dzika rnams kyis brtan par bya ste/ mchod pa gsar pa rnams byin gyis rlabs/ rnying pa rnams kha gso ba'o/ /dang po ki li ki li 'i phyag rgya las rdo rje thal mor bya/ de nas mnyam pa'i thal mor byed pa ni/ mchod pa thams cad kyi spyi'i sngon 'gro'o/ / bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das sogs dang*/ spyi 'gro'i mthar rdo rje nang bsdams las/ gung mdzub rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dra rung*/ mthe bong gnyis 'dzub mo'i ngos la sbyar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ lan gsum sogs mang du brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bkrus gyur pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis lha rnams la/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba de ba ta ar tsi ta a mṛ ta swāhā/ 'dir me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la dngos su khrus gsol na phyag rgya mi dgos/ gzhan du na mnyam pa'i thal mo kha phye/ mtheb mdzub rtse spras pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /dngos sam yid kyi na bza' dang rgyan gsol/ dud dang rdza rnga dang gling bu dang pi waṃ la sogs pa 'bud pa dang*/ dkrol ba dang*/ brdung ba'i rol mo bya ste/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod par bya'o/ / dri med mtshan la sgrib gsal mi mnga' yang*/

/dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yi/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas brtul bzhugs mchog la spyod par shog /sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhi bzhin rab bkra yang*/ /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ / bzod pa dam pa gos gyis brgyan par shog /bde gshegs sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad dang*/ /rin chen 'od chags 'bar bas dbu rgyan zhing*/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyan gyis mdzes mod kyi/ /'jig rten bkur bsti rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /rin chen 'phreng ba do shal se mo do/ /rgyan gyi dam pa khyad par mchog phul bas/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog gi rgyan dang ldan/ /bla med thar pa mchog la gnas par shog /theg mchog bla bre mgon skyabs gdugs dang bcas/ /bdud bcom rgyal mtshan ba dan ting 'dzin 'phan/ /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par rab brgyan pas/ /bla bre 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo brjid/ /bdug spos dri zhim sil snyan sprin tshogs 'khrigs/ bdag dang 'gro ba'i don du 'di 'bul gyi/ /dbang mchog dam pa dus 'dir thob 'gyur te/ /gnod pa'i dgra 'joms bla med go 'phang la/ / theg pa mchog gis nges par bsgrod par shog / ces pa'ang spro na brjod par bya'o/ /de nas nyer spyod nges par 'bul te/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/ lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyed par mdzod/ /ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+ya dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ phyag rgya spyi 'gro sngon du 'gro bas/ lag pa g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi 'khrig ma nas g.yon pas gzung ba'o/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di/ / bdag ni dad pas= sogs/ ā ha ra= sogs/ spyi 'gro sngon du song ba'i lag gnyis sor mo gzhan rnams phan tshun bsnol/

mdzub mo gnyis gdub bu'i tshul du rtse sprad/ mthe bong mdzub mo'i glor bzhag pa'o/ /dri yi sbyar ba lha yi rdzas/ /nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di/ bdag ni= ā ha ra= spyi 'gro sngon du song bas mthe chung srin lag gus mo rnams snga ma snga ma'i rgyab tu phyi ma phyi ma sbyar/ de rnams g.yas g.yon phan tshun rtse sprad/ mdzub mo brkyang zhing mthe bong de'i glor bzhag pa'o/ /sman rnams bcud ni yi gar 'ong*/ /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag ni= ā ha ra= spyi 'gro sngon du song nas/ snyim pa kha sbyor bzed pa las/ mdzub mo cung zad bkugs pa'o/ / gnod rnams 'joms shing bkra shis la/ dge zhing mun pa rnams sel 'di/ bdag ni= ā lo ka ā lo ka sarba bid+ya dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ spyi 'gro sngon du btang*/ khu tshur gnyis gshibs pa las mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sbyar te bsgreng ba'o/ / oṃ sems can gyi khams na gang nga yi ba med cing yongs su gzung ba med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs chu dang thang las skyes pa/ rin po che'i ri dang*/ rgya mtsho'i rin po che la sogs pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mchod pa'i 'phrin las kyis dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs kyi stobs dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams kyi stobs dang*/ rig pa'i gsang sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du mchog tu rgya che ba'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mchog rgya chen po'i gong ma las bla mar mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rab tu 'bab par gyur cig /na maḥsarba budha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba thā ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ sngags 'di lan brgyad brjod/ so brgyad pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/

zhes pa la sogs pa dam tshig gsum gyi bstod pas bstod do/ /bod du 'gyur ba ltar na/ bya spyod kyi rgyud las bstod pa 'di ma bshad pa 'dra ba zhig yod kyang*/ spyir bstod pa tsam la yi ge'i don la bltas te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gsal po med na/ gong ma'ang 'og tu blangs pas chog pa yin mod kyi/ 'di ni dam tshig gsum bkod nyid kyi bstod pa yin par slob dpon rin chen 'byung ldan sbas pas bshad de/ bod du ma 'gyur ba'i bya spyod kyi rgyud las kyang bshad par mngon no// mgon po thugs rjes che ldan pa= sogs/ gzhan yang ji ltar 'os pas bstod pa'i mthar/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ sarba trā sa ma ku su mi ta a bhi dz+nyā/ rā shi ni na ma stu te swāhā/ zhes bstod pa 'byung ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po yang lan brgyad brjod do/ / so dgu pa bshags pa ni/ /'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na/ zhes pa nas/ slan chad de ltar yongs mi bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar spyi rgyud legs grub las 'byung ba ltar ram/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud las 'byung ba ltar na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes pa'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug las skyes pa'i sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs bskyed pa gang gis bshags par mdzad pa'i sems bskyed pa des bshags par bya ste/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mkhyen pa ltar/ des kyang ci tsam du bshags par nus pa de tsam du bshags par bgyi'o/ slan chad/ de lta bu mi bgyid do/ / spyi rgyud kyi cho ga la yi rang logs su med pas 'di'i don tshan zhe drug la mi bgrod yang rgyud 'dir gsungs pas bshags pa 'di'i 'phros las rjes su yi rang ba yang bya ste/ gang du gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/

nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs sems can gyi khams rnam par sbyong bar byed pa/ sems can gyi khams yongs su srung bar byed pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba bla na med pas rjes su yid rang bar bya ste/ ji ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas mkhyen pa ltar bdag gis kyang ji ltar rjes su yid rang bar nus pa de ltar rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ / bzhi bcu pa skyabs 'gro ni/ srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag ni ji srid 'tsho bar du/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge bdun la/ /gus pas yang dag skyabs su 'chi/ / zhe gcig pa gsol gdab ni/ mi rtog blo gros bskyed pa'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /gdul bya ji srid tshim bar du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ / zhe gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i//sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang*/ /ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang*/ /nyon mongs rnams las dgrol ba'i phyir/ /srid pa'i mi dge dog pa na/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs ci mchis pa/ /de ltar yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ / zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/

sems can 'phongs pa thams cad kyi/ /skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu shog /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /rten med rnams kyi rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing*/ sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang*/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang*/ /'di dang gzhan du bsags pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes zhes bya ba'i/ /tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug bsgoms nas/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa/ /de yang sems can ma lus pa/ /thams cad la ni phan par shog /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ / bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su/ /de bzhin du ni smon lam 'debs/ / sems can thams cad bde ba dang*/ /thams cad nad kyang med par shog / bdag ni bya ba kun nus shing*/ /yon tan dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can/ /bzod ldan dge la dad pa dang*/ /sems can tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog / ces pa'ang bya zhing*/ gang ltar yang mthar/ tshe yi mtha' klas gang byed dang*/ /gang yang cung zad byed 'gyur pa/ / mdor na sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mong thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /grol bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad cing*/ /byang chub rab tu dga' brtson no/ /zhes pa'o/ / zhe gsum pa tshad med bzhi ni/ /don yid la dran bzhin pas tshig gi brjod tshul spyi dang mthun par brjod do/ /zhe bzhi pa bzlas brjod kyi rim pa la sngon 'gro ni/ oṃ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lus kyi sprul pa'i sprin sems can thams cad kyi dmigs pa las byung ba/ sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba/ bde ba thams cad myur du stsol ba/ zag pa med pa'i dge ba 'byung ba'i sbyor ba yang dag par 'byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi grub pa'i mchog de sems can thams cad kyis thob par gyur cig

na maḥsarba bud+dha bodhī satwā nāṃ/ na mastu te mahā badz+ra sarba satwa hi taṃ ka ra tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba tra sarbe khāṃ/ dharmā ṇāṃ a dhiṣ+ṭhā ya swāhā/ smon lam dang sngags de sbyar ba lan brgyad dam smon lam tshar gcig gi mthar sngags lan brgyad brjod/ de ltar mngon par 'dus byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi bsdus pa 'di thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ / zhes bsngo ba dang*/ bdag sdug bsngal par gyur pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis rnam pa thams cad du byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ bdag la grub pa'i mchog stsol cig / ces gsol ba gdab bo/ /bzlas pa'i sngon 'gro gsum po de dag ni dam tshig gsum bkod kho na'i dgos chos te/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sprin sgrub pa dang*/ sems can gyi khams thams cad sbyong ba dang*/ sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i rigs pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga'o/ /spyi'i cho ga'i lugs la yongs nas bsngo ba ni dgos mod kyang*/ sems bskyed kyi nang na yod pas logs su med kyang de'i chog go / na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes lan mang du brjod pas bla ma la phyag bya'o/ /de nas pu to tse'i 'bru'am dge ba'i shing la ril bus byas pa'i ril bu stong rtsa brgyad dam/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig blangs la/ mdun du khro bo legs grub bam/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje skad gcig gis bsam te/ na mo rat+na trā yā ya/ oṃ ata bhu ti bi dza ya sid+dhi sid+dhā r+the swāhā/ zhes pa de bzhin gshegs rigs spyi khyab kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i sngags lan bdun bzlas/ de nas mig phug lte ba'i rnam pa lngas bkrus la/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa sum sgril gyis brgyus/ mdud pa btab ste lha la mchod par byas nas bsnyim par bcug ste/

de bzhin gshegs rigs kyis 'phreng ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o/ /de yang 'di lta ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sid+dhi sādha ya sādha ya/ sid+dha r+the swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /'di ni bgrang 'phreng rab gnas yin pas dang por nges par bya la/ gzhan gyi mthong ba'am reg pa'ang 'bags pa la sogs pa/ rab gnas nyams pa'am nyams par dogs na/ spos chus bkrus shing bdug spos kyi bdugs la slar rab gnas de nyid bskyar te bya/ dkyus kyi nyams len la ni/ bgrang 'phreng rab gnas mi dgos kyang*/ byin rlabs gso ba'i phyir dang blo byang ba'i phyir/ sngags gnyis po de tshar re'am gsum te brjod do/ / de nas lag pa g.yas kyis bgrang 'phreng bzung ba'am/ dal bar gyur na ngal gso ba'i don du g.yon pas kyang bzung*/ gang ltar yang bgrang 'phreng snying gar bzung ste/ gung mo dang mthe chung bskyang*/ mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab tu bkug cing sbyar/ srin lag gi steng nas mthe bong bgrong ba yin la/ dmigs pa ni/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags 'phreng bkod pa la dmigs pa ste de nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /'dir bzlas bya'i sngags kyi gtso bo ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa ste/ na maḥs+t+rai ya d+dhi kā naṃ/ ta thā ga tā nā ཾ / sarba tra a pra ti ha tā bāsti/ dharma tā ba lī nāṃ/ aṃ a sa ma sa man+ta to a nan+ta bāsti/ shā sa ni/ ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇa/ bi ga ta rā ga bud+dha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra/ sa ma ba la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na mahā ba ra lak+ṣa ṇa/ dz+wa la dz+wa la na sā ga re swāhā/ zhes pa nyid ci nus su bzla bar bya'o/ / sngags bsdus pa ni/ slob dpon ku mu ta 'byung gnas kyi sgrub thabs las/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ ā bī ra hūṃ khaṃ/ zhes 'byung*/ rgyud nyid las/ na maḥsar+b+ba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ ā bī ra hūṃ khaṃ/ zhes 'byung ngo*/ /bzlas brjod kyi rjes kyi bya ba ni/ bzlas pa'i mthar bum pa'i phyag brgya bcas la/

bdag gi bzlas brjod kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub kyi don du bcom ldan 'das la 'bul lo/ /'phags pa khyed kyis bdag la dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ 'di ni mtshon byed de rang gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub de zhu'o/ /bum pa'i phyag rgya ni/ lag gnyis srin lag gi rgyab tu gung mo sbyar/ de gnyis g.yon pa'i mdun du g.yas pa'i rgyab sbyar te bsnol/ g.yas kyi mdzub mo g.yon gyi gung srin dang*/ g.yon gyi mdzub mo g.yas kyi gung srin la 'khyud/ mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo'i tshigs dbus ma la bzhag /mthe chung gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba'o/ /de nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad kyis sdug bsngal bar gyur pa bdag yongs su bzung du gsol/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i phyag rgya rang gi spyi bor bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ ga ga ne ga ga ne / zhes pa lan gsum/ thun mong gi cho gas dzi na dzika lan gsum brjod/ mgo bo'am/ snying gar zla ba la bh+rūṃ yig byung bar bsam/ de nas sems can don gyi spyod pa la 'jug pa'i slad du dngos gzhi'i bzlas brjod dang ting nge 'dzin grol bar bya'o/ /zhe lnga pa slar btang ba ni/ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swāhā dang*/ ā ha ra= sogs nyer spyod lnga'i sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod/ spro na/ sems can gyi khams na= zhes pa nas/ khaṃ swāhā 'i bar brjod na'ang legs/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan= sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis bstod/ bzod gsol gyi tshig spyi 'gro rnams brjod/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu na ye swāhā/ oṃ ar+ya mahā badz+ra dha rā ya swāhā/ oṃ ar+ya badz+ra dha rā swāhā/ oṃ du ta a nan+ta ya swāhā/ oṃ du ti a nan t+yai swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de ltar mchod yon phul rjes spyan 'dren pa'i phyag brgya mthe bong gnyis phyir bskyed/

gshegs gsol gyi tshig spyi 'gro'i mthar/ gdon mi za bar bdag la yang*/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs nas ni/ / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams/ /ci bde bar ni gshegs su gsol/ dang po bcings pa'i de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya de mgo bo'i steng du bcas/ rtse mo gyen du bstan/ sor mo bskyod cing dkrol te/ se gol gtogs pa lan gsum dang*/ oṃ ta thā ga to da bha wā ya swāhā/ zhes lan gsum kyis/ lha rnams gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ de'i rjes su mi nyams pa'i yan lag gi phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ g.yon pa'i thal mo gan kyal gyi steng du g.yas pa'i rgyab sbyar/ sor mo rnams bsnol ba'i rtse mo bkug ste/ rtsa ba'i phyogs su bstan pa g.yon du bskor te/ oṃ hu lu hu lu tsaṇ+ḍa li ma taṃ gi swāhā/ zhes gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i rigs pas rwa ba la sogs pa dgrol bar bya'o/ /zhe drug pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba ni/ bdag gi bzlas brjod bgyis pa dang*/ mchod pa byas pa dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa dang*/ smon lam rgya chen po byas pa dang*/ sdig pa rnams so sor bshags pa dang*/ dus gsum du byung ba'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang/ rjes su yi rang ba yang sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyu nyid du rab tu sbyor bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs shing*/ sems can gyi don 'byung bar gyur cig /bdag gi bsod nams kyi stobs dang*/ smon lam gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bdag la byin gyis rlabs zhing*/ sems can thams cad kyi don mi zad pa ni 'byung bar gyur cig /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /stobs bcu mkhyen pa'i sa la sems can thams cad so sor gnas par gyur cig

/ ces smon lam gdab/ rgyas par rgyud nyid las 'byung ba ltar smon lam gzhan yang gdab par bya'o/ /de nas gtan de las langs te/ khri'u gtsang ma la bkur sti dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i mdo sde'i glegs bam dag bzhugs su gsol nas bklag par bya zhing*/ tha na phyag 'tshal ba tsam yang nges par dgos so/ kha zas la 'jug pa na/ oṃ o ka dz+wa la badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ phaṭa/ bsrung ba bya/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ oṃ ba le na da de te dzo mā li ni swāhā/ zhes lan brgyad kyi mngags te/ kham dang po lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ de nas zos te khrus bya'o/ khrus byed pa na bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas so/ /nyal ba na stobs po che'i sngags kyis bsrungs la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ shwa ri'i bu rnams la phyag byas te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhig /rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ chos kyi 'du shes kyis nyal lo/ /de bzhin du rjes dran drug dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ sā tsha 'debs pa dang*/ snod dag par byed pa dang*/ gos bgo ba'i sngags dang*/ dngos dang rmi lam du 'dzag pa srung ba sogs kyang bya la/ ba ser skya'i rnam lnga la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te uṣ+ṇi ṣa ya/ oṃ bi shud+dhe bi ra dze shī ba shān ti ka re swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas te btungs pas ni/ zla ba phyed kyi bza' min gyi nyes pa thams cad byang bar gsungs so/ /de yan dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i le'u las 'byung bar bsnyen pa'i cho ga gang yin pa de/ bya ba spyi rgyud rnams kyi cho gas kha bskang ste bshad zin to/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na bshags pa/

skyabs 'gro /gsol btab/ sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi rnams bdag phul ba'i rjes bgegs srung ba'i sngon du byas na/ de skabs gyi sems bskyed de mi dgos pa dang*/ 'og tu bstod pa'i de ma thag par bzlas pa byas na/ /mi rung pa med cing rnam pa/ gcig tu na legs pa'ang yin no/ /'di ni bsnyen pa'i cho ga yin la/ 'di yis nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba na sgrub pa la 'jug cing*/ lha'i rnal 'byor la sems brtan pa thob la/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje sngags kyi nus pa shar ba'i sgrub pa po'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rgyud las 'di skad ces gsungs te/ ri bo'i gseb tu 'bum bzlas pa byas na/ 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis kyis ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams so/ /gsum gyi ni byang chub sems pa rnams dang smra bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhis ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsungs thos par 'gyur ro/ /lngas ni gzungs rnams thob par 'gyur ro// drug gis nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bdun gyis mngon par shes pa lnga rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad kyis sangs rgyas thams cad la mngon par mchod par 'gyur ro/ /dgus ni mya ngan las 'das pa mngon par sgrub par byed do/ /bcus ni 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su rgyu bar 'gyur ro/ /'di dag ni thams la mkhas pa'i bzlas pa'i cho ga ste/ mtha' yas pa'i 'bras bu mngon par shes par thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur pa'o/ /thabs la mi mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ brtson 'grus rab dang 'bring dang tha mas ji ltar bsnyen pa de ltar rab tu sbyar na nub gcig gis rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur te snga ma bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'bras bu rim pa bcu po de ni mos pas spyod pa'i sa bcu yin par mngon no/ /skabs 'dir 'di snyam du bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed kyang med la/ mdun bskyed la yang sngags sogs sa bon las dam tshig gis bskyed pa dang*/

ye shes pa spyan drangs te bsre ba med na/ lha drug gi dbye ba bshad pa dang 'gal bar gyur snyam na/ 'dir dang por 'khrus byas rnal 'byor pas zhes sogs/ lha drug ston byed kyi gzhung tshig de bod du 'gyur ba'i rgyud na ni med la/ rnam 'joms kyi 'grel pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad par grags pa na/ lung 'dren gyi tshul du yod pa las de rnam 'joms rgyas pa'i lung yin par grags mod kyi/ rnam 'joms kyi rgyud yin du chug kyang rnam 'joms kyi rgyud yin tshad bya rgyu yin par ma nges pa'i phyir dang*/ 'grel pa de yang tshig don bzang mod tshig gi babs la dpags na snga 'gyur dus kyi zin bris bod ma zhig tu gsal ba'i phyir dang*/ mchod dang gsol ba lha drug bsgom/ /stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang*/ zhes pa lta bu rgya skad tshig ring po thung ngur bsdus pa'am/ /rgya skad rkang pa gsum bod skad rkang pa gnyis la bsdus pa'am/ rgya skad tshig lhug pa tshigs bcad yi ge shin tu nyung ngur bsdus pa lta bu'am/ tshigs bcad la rig byed kyi gsang ba'i gab tshig skad 'dod bsgrigs pa lta bu yod na ma gtogs/ rjes sngags dang*/ kha sgo la sogs pa tshigs bcad yig 'bru brgyad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi tshig rkang gnyis la 'grig dka' bar snang zhing*/ tshig lam yang bod ma'i sdoms 'dra rung ba snang ba/ des na tshig 'di ni bod kyi sdoms tshig snying pa yin yang dag cing*/ ches snga ba'i yig rnying las dpe gsar du spel ba rnams la mchan bu dkyus su shor ba'i nor ba yang mang bas lung khungs smos pa yang rtsom pa pos byas par ma nges pa'i phyir dang*/ bya rgyud rang rkang la ni/ lha drug gi rnam gzhag nged par 'chad dgos pa mi snang bas/ de 'dra'i rnam gzhag nges par dgos pa min la/ ci ste byed na sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa rnams ni spyod rgyud kyi lugs yin pas 'dir de ltar mi bya'o/

/'dir ni lha sku la dmigs pa'am ma dmigs kyang rung ste/ bdag gi de kho na nyid la dmigs pa'i skabs sogs su/ /chos kyi bdag med pa'i don sgom pa ni stong pa nyid kyi lha/ mdun skyed gtso bo'i thugs kar sngags kyi yig 'bru bsgom pa ni yi ge'i lha/ sngags kyi sgra la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan ni sgra'i lha/ /lha'i sku la dmigs pa ni gzugs kyi lha/ lha so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing ba ni phyag rgya'i lha/ thun mtshams su bar chad mi 'jug cing byin rlabs brtan pa'i don du/ thun gtor khar phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag pas/ rtags kyi tshul du yig 'bru bsam pa ni mtshan ma'i lha'o/ /'dir bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid kyang*/ lha dang yi ger dang sgra dang phyag mtshan dang thig le dang 'od zer la sogs pa la dmigs nas/ stong nyid snying rje sgom pa rnams mdun skyed kho na la dmigs nas bya ba yin gyi/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol zhes sogs kyis bzlas brjod dang*/ gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i bsam gtan ni bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs la mi sbyor ro/ / sangs rgyas gsang bas/ bya rgyud rnams rang lugs mi mdzad par sbyong rgyud du 'grel bar mdzad pa de bod pa'i chen po mang pos ma dgongs pa dang*/ phyis kyi sgrin po mang pos rgyud 'bum btu mkhan rnams kyis bya rgyud kyi po ti'i sde tshan gyi gseb la rgyud sde gong mar gtogs pa mang po ngo ma shes par shor ba rnams bya rgyud du bdag bskyed yod pa'i rgyab rten du 'dren pa sogs cal col du ma yod pa rnams 'dzug tshugs bstan pa tsam gyi 'khrul pa sangs par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i le'u las 'byung ba lha lnga'i sgo nas/ bsnyen pa'i cho ga spyi rgyud nas 'byung ba'i kha skongs dang bcas pa legs par bshad pa yin no/ / da ni dbang bskur ba dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdo tsam bshad par bya'o/

/de la slob dpon dang*/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ yul phyogs dang dus dang*/ dkyil 'khor kyi sa gzhi'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /'dir cho ga dngos la sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes kyi cho ga ste drug go /dang po las sbyang ba dang*/ bzung ba gnyis so/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ stobs bcu mkhyen pa'i sa la sems can thams cad so sor gnas par gyur cig gi bar gong du bsnyen pa'i cho gar bshad pa ltar gyi bsgrub thabs rdzogs par bsgom/ /sa phyogs gtsang zhing byi dor byas pa la me tog sil ma cung zad gtor/ dkar gtor gcig la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul zhes bya ba rdor bsdams kyi phyag rgya btab te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ a d+ya nu t+pan+na twata/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ka bh+yaḥ zhes sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis rgya cher spel/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan bdun sogs kyis phul/ gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid yul bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa yul phyogs kyi gtso bo dang sa'i bdag po thams cad la 'bul lo/ /mchod yon dang dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang snang gsal dang na bza' la sogs pa yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ gnod sems zhi zhing*/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi don du sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsol ba dang zhi ba dang bde ba dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin mo'am gzhan dag la/

/sa 'di bdag gis slang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ lan gsum/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /'di don gyis slang ba yin/ 'ga' zhig 'di lta bu bya rgyud las ma bshad ces mi byed pa ni/ snga ma rnams kyi lag len ma nor ba'i rgyun la brnyas pa byed cing*/ mthong rgya phra ma'i khengs pas yul dus gang du gang dgos ma shes par bgegs kyi bar chad ched kyis nyo bar zad la/ 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi mtha' rgya bskyed dgos pa'i phra mo mang po zhig la/ yul dus dang bstun pa'i lag len dgos kyi/ ga ge mo'i lugs la de dang de yod do med do zhes tshig rtseg than thun la mgul ba chad chad du rtsod pa dang*/ bshad khungs phran tshags re gdong thad der yod med kyi dbu tshugs mi 'gro ste/ sngon rgya gar du paṇ+ḍi ta gsum gyis gzhung lugs dang bstun nas lto g.yos pa'i dper 'gro nyen yod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la lag pas byugs shing*/ cab be cab be byas te/ oṃ ki li kī la badz+ra bhi ma rau tri ba bi tra mahā kro dha bi dzā ya/ ni krin ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ban+dha ban+dha swāhā/ zhes mang du bzla'o/ /de nas oṃ kī li kī la badz+ri badz+ri bhu ra ban+dha huṃ phaṭa/ ces seng lding gi phur bu sor brgyad pa btab/ ki li kī las bsangs gtor byed pa nas brtsams te/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyi rol du me dpung 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar mtshams bcings shing slar yang seng lding gi phur bu la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyi sngags bsdus pa dang*/ oṃṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā/ zhes las thams cad pa mang du bzlas/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ nā maḥs man+ta badz+ra r+ṇaṃ/ ā ko ṭa ya/ sa he mahā tsaṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba tra rak+ṣaṃ tra ṭa ma ṭa ma ṭa phaṭa/ ces phur bu tho bas brdung bar bya'o/ /sngags 'di dam tshig gsum bkod nyid las gsungs so/

/ phur bu ni phyogs mtshams brgyad dam/ mtshams bzhi'am ma 'byor na dbus su gcig gdab bo/ / gnyis pa sa bzung ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ sems can thams cad so sor gnas par gyur cig / gi bar sgrub thabs rdzogs par bsgom nas las rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ dza ya uṣ+ṇi ṣa dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ban+dha ban+dha/da ma da ma/oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ha na hūṃ/ zhes gtsug tor rgyal ba'i sngags kyis bsangs gtor bya/ bh+rūṃ dang*/ dzi na dzika dang*/ rtsa sngags de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa bzla bzhin du/ sa la lag pas byugs shing bcabs nas/ sa'i phyogs 'di bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya'o/ / zhes brjod/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i sras bu la/ las thams cad pa'am/ bdud rtsi thal sbyor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gangarung zhig la lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bzlas/ mdud pa gsum mam bdun btab ste slob mar 'gyur ba'i mgul lam dpung par btags pas slob ma rnams kyi bgegs thams cad zhi zhing srung ba byas par 'gyur/ 'di spyi la grags pa'i slob ma rjes bzung dang dgos don gcig mod/ spyir rgyud kyi dpe kha cig las/ de nas slob ma yongs bzung nas/ zhes 'byung ba ni yig nor brgyud pa ste/ dpe 'ga' las/ des ni slob ma yongs bzung ba'i/ /las la bgegs ni med par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar dag ste/ yongs su bzung zin pa'i slob ma la srung ba byed pa'o/ /'di la rjes bzung gi tha snyad byed pa rnams ni sgrub byed de gdod tshol dgos so/ /skabs 'dir gsang ba spyi rgyud las spyir btang du/ sa sbyang ba ni dkyil 'khor bri ba'i snga rol gyi zhag bdun gyi nang logs dang*/ sa bzung ba ni bri ba'i zhag gsum gyi sngon nas byed par gsungs la/ dmigs gsal la gcig tu ma nges pas da lta'i lag len ltar na/ nyi ma dang po la sa sbyangs ba dang*/

gnyis pa la bzung ba lta bu byas na'ang rung*/ yang spyi rgyud las/ nub gsum gyi cho ga rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi bzung*/ zhes sa chog gi sde gnyis kar nyi ma gcig la tshang bar byas na'ang legs par 'gyur ro/ /de la rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pas ni/ slob dpon gyis tshad dang ldan pa'i bsnyen pa song zhing ma nyams pa yin na/ skabs 'dir sa chog gnyis kyi cho ga'i yan lag tu bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang 'dra ba'i sgrub thabs tshar re sgom pa de nges par sngon du 'gro dgos pa min pas/ skabs 'dir bzlas brjod dang lha'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul la gsungs pa ni/ don la dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga tshang bar 'gyur ba tsam la/ skabs 'dir sgrub thabs bsgom mi dgos kyang dang por ni rang gzhan gyi bsod nams spel ba'i slad dang*/ gnyis par na byin rlabs nye ba'i phyir dang*/ gsum par na cho ga mdzes pa'i ched dang*/ bzhi par na da lta'i gang zag dman pa cho ga tsam don gnyer gyis kyang bsnyen pa'i cho ga mi spong zhi blo byang bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod pas/ sa sbyangs bzung nyin zhag so sor byed na/ nyin re bzhin skyabs 'gro nas bsams te/ tha ma'i smon lam gyi bar gyi sgrub thabs tshar re sngon du btang nas/ de dang de la 'jug pa yin la/ sbyangs bzung nyi ma gcig la byed na ni/ sbyang ba'i sngon du sgrub thabs tshar gcig bsgoms pa de kas chog go /gnyis pa sta gon du gnas pa la/ lha sta gon dang*/ slob ma sta gon dang*/ bum pa sta gon gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon khyim pa yin na nang par thog ma la bsnyen gnas blangs/ nyi ma 'char ba'i skabs thur ma'am dbyug gu bslang bas/ phyogs brtags de ma nor bar skam thig thig chen brgyad tsam 'debs shing sgo sprag gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bri na rtsa thig rim pa gsum ka'i thad du thig re gdab dgos la/ lha rnams gang du 'god pa'i gnas sogs nges par byas nas de dag tu rtags btab bo/

/snga dro'am nyin gung sogs ji ltar 'os pa sgrub thabs tshar cig bsgoms nas bzlas brjod kyang mang du+u bya/ ci ste snga dro sa chog dang dgong mo sta gon byed pa yin na/ sa chog gi mgor sgrub thabs thog mar bsgoms pa de kho nas chog gi slang yang skabs 'dir mi dgos mod/ spyir sa chog dang sta gon nyin zhag gcig la bsgrubs pas go mi chod pa rang yang min mod/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pas mi legs so/ /dgongs ka'i dus na gong du bshad pa ltar bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi lha spyan 'dren pa yid la bzhag nas/ bh+rūṃ/ bdun dang*/ dzi na dzika bdun dang*/ oṃ ṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya gsum dang*/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi= zhes pa nas/ dgyes par mdzad/ bh+rūṃ bdun dang*/ dzi na dzika bdun dang*/ oṃ bha ga wan mahā kā ru ṇi ka shākya mu ni tri sa ma ya rā dza maṇ+ḍal de ba tā sa pā ri wa ra e h+yai hi/ lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir dbus su sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad tsam du dri bzang gi gru bzhir byug cing*/ dzi na dzika zhes pa rigs kyi snying po lan bdun dang*/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu na ye swāhā/ gtso bo'i mtshan sngags lan gsum/ dbus kyi gdan gyi stengs su bcom ldan 'das sogs nas/ lha gzhan rnams kyi gnas su dri'i thig le byed bzhin pas/ oṃ ār+ya badz+ra dha ra swāhā/ g.yas su 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin chen po/ sogs nas/ gdan la brten pa/ oṃ ār+ya badz+ra dha rā swāhā/ gtso bo'i g.yon du 'phags ma rdo rje 'dzin sogs nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /oṃ du ta a nan+tā ya swāhā/ g.yas kyi 'og tu= sogs nas/ rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ du ti a nan+d+yai= sogs nas/ g.yon gyi 'og tu= sogs nas/ bzhugs par gyur/ lha lnga nyid la de tsam gyis chog cing*/ lha lnga'i dbang gis go mi chod pa ta min mod/ cung zad rgyud smin stobs chung la/ spyi rgyud ltar sbyar na slob ma smin tshabs che bar 'ong ba'i phyir/

spyi rgyud nas kha 'gengs byed dgos pas na 'di ltar bya ste/ gtso bo'i mdun ngos kyi 'og tu/ oṃ mahā kro dha a pa ra dzi ta swāhā/ khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang*/ oṃ bha ga wa t+yai a pa ra dzi tā swāhā/ bcom ldan khro mo gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang*/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ne swāhā/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ oṃ ur+ṇī swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' mdzod spu can dang*/ oṃ shū lī swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' mdung thung can dang*/ oṃ tsakra brti mahā ud+bha we swāhā / byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los bsgyur ba cher 'byung dang*/ oṃ tsin+tā ma ṇi dh+wa dzā ya swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ku mā ra bhū tā ya swāhā/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa dang*/ oṃ mahā s+thā ma/ pra stā ya swāhā/ rgyal sras mthu chen thob pa dang*/ oṃ ā ka sha gar+bhā ya swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dhi ya swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa dang*/ oṃ bi ma la ma ti swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med pa'i blo gros dang*/ oṃ ār+ya ma ཻ tri swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa byams pa dang*/ oṃ mā ma kī swāhā/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo mā ma kī dang*/ oṃ mahā bir+ya swāhā/ mngags gzhug pa brtson 'grus chen po dang*/ oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ lha'i rgyal po mchod sbyin brgya pa dang*/ oṃ a di t+ya swāhā/ lha'i bu nyi ma dang*/ oṃ shī ta aṃ shu swāhā/ lha'i bu zla ba dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ drang srong chen po me lha dang*/ oṃ ya ma ye swāhā/ gshin rje'i rgyal po dang*/ oṃ rak+ṣā sa ti pa ya swāhā/ srin po'i rgyal po dang*/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ya swāhā/ chu yi bdag po dang*/ oṃ bā ya be swāhā/ rlung lha'i rgyal po dang*/ oṃ ku be ra swāhā/

gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon lus ngan po dang*/ oṃ i shā na ya swāhā/ 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan dang*/ oṃ pri th+wī de wī swāhā/ sa'i lha mo chen mo dang*/ oṃ nan+ta nā gā ya swāhā/ oṃ u pa nan+da nā gā ya swāhā/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang*/ gnyen dga' bo dang*/ oṃ ha ri t+yai swāhā/ gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma dang*/ sgo srung 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi byed na/ oṃ dhṛ ta raṣ+ta ya swāhā/ zhes sogs kyang bya/ gzhal yas khang 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyi'i sa gzhi la/ oṃ badz+ra se na swāhā/ rdo rje sde dang*/ oṃ su ba hu swāhā/ lag bzang dang*/ oṃ murtā na ta kā ya swāhā/ bgegs kyi ded dpon chen po tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ oṃ ru ṭa ma he shwa rā ya swāhā/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ oṃ prah+mā ya swāhā/ tshangs pa chen po dang*/ rigs lnga 'chang gi rgyal po yang*/ /glang po che zhes bya ba dang*/ /yan lag bkras 'byin rtse bran can/ / g.yon phyogs cod pan mig bzang dang*/ /sna tshogs 'od dang legs par grub// bdun po lho yi phyogs su bzhugs/ / 'dir lha'i mtshan brjod pas gsal 'debs pa la/ kha gcig shākya thub pa zhes pa lta bu kho na byed zer ba ni lag len dang man ngag med par spyi rgyud bklags pa tsam gyis tshim pa'i skyon te rang lugs la thog mthar oṃ dang swāhā sbyor/ de dag la sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i cho gas/

dzi na dzika oṃ te dza te dza= nas/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma 'i bar du mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ mchod yon nas brtsams te bstod pa rdzogs kyi bar mchod bstod 'bul/ 'grub na lha mnyes pa'i phyir sreg blugs kyi mchod pa bya la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang sangs rgyas kun la dmigs nas/ ā ha ra= la sogs pa'i sngags kyis nyer spyod lnga phul/ bdug spos 'thul bzhin du/ dam tshig gsum rgyal bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*/ /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su lha yi spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dam tshig gsum bkod dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus par nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ / dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar gnas por mdzad pa'i rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ kha cig bdag ming zhes pa'i thad du/ gsang mtshan 'jug pa sogs ni rgyud sde gong ma la rung yang*/ 'dir rang ming nyid 'jug pa'o/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa= sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis phyag btsal/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sa bstod/ rtsa ba'i sngags de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ dzi na dzika gis mngags pa'i mchod yon/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā sa phul/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ kha gcig sta gon gyi lha dran rdzogs su bskyed pa yin pas/

skabs 'dir mi snang bar bsam pa kho nas chog ces 'dod la/ gzhan dag sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren dgos pas/ 'dir yang gshegs gsol gyi cho gas spyan drangs dgos so zhes 'dod do/ /de gnyis kar rung ba las spyan drangs te gshegs su gsol ba nyid/ mchog tu bzang bar mngon no/ /bod du phyis byung ba bya rgyud shes par rlom pa dag cig /snyan gsan 'bebs pa dang gshegs su gsol ba 'di/ 'khyor chu dang ku sha sbyin pa'i bar du byed pa rgyud kyi khyad chos su sgom par 'dug na'ang man ngag dang lag len med pas nyes te/ rgyud phal cher du cho ga'i go rim 'khrugs can du 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang ste/ sta gon gyi slob ma byin rlabs dang so shing 'dor ba'i gzhung tshig gi bar skabs der/ dbang bskur ba yi bum pa ni/ zhes sogs bum pa sta gon gsungs pa dang 'dra bas cho ga rigs mthun gyi gzhung rnams sgrig lugs shes dgos la/ lha la snyan gsan 'bebs pa la slob ma dbab por dgos pa ga la zhig ste/ cho ga'i go rim gyi tshoms de lta bu mi bya'o/ /de dag ni lha sta gon gyi rim pa ste/ spyi dang mthun shas che la/ kha cig skabs 'dir slob ma la so shing sbyin te/ sbyin sreg byed dgos shing*/ de yang slob ma rjes bzung ngo zhes zer ba ni spyi rgyud las/ rtse mo nas ni btsal bar bya/ zhes sogs 'phros don la 'khrul gzhi byung bar snang ste/ skabs 'dir so shing la sogs pa grabs su chud par byed pa tsam rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin gyi slob ma la ster ba min no/ /gnyis pa slob ma sta gon ni thog mar slob ma'i bar chad zhi ba'i don du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ slob ma de sngar khyim pa phal pa yin na dge bsnyen sogs so thar rigs bdun po gang rung gcig gi sdom pa thob dgos te/ dkyil 'khor khang par ma zhugs pa'i sngon rol du grub pa zhig dgos la/ sngar so thar sdom pa gang rung zhig thob la ma nyams pa yin na/

skabs 'dir so thar gyi cho ga mi dgos so/ /slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa lhag gnas byed pa'am gnas khang gzhan du yang rung la/ gang ltar na'ang khrus byas gral du 'khod/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pas smon 'jug gi sdom pa phog na ches bzang la/ gal te ma 'grub na yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi spros pa spangs te/ skyabs 'gro dang smon pa sems bskyed kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i sems bskyed 'bogs so/ /skyabs sems kyi dngos gzhi tsam du 'bogs pa 'di ni/ sngar gzhan du byang sdom thob la ma nyams pa yin kyang*/ skabs 'dir 'bogs dgos te cho ga'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir/ dper na dkyil chog gzhan gyi rgyun bshags bzhin no/ /yang cho ga shin tu bsdus pa la mngon par dga' ba'i tshe/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ sogs dang*/ sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i/ sogs tshig rkang brgyad dang*/ tshe yi mtha' klas byed pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub rab tu dga' brtson no/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis kyang grub bo/ /de ltar rgyud sbyangs nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ zhes pa nas/ 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ ces pa'i bar brjod cing don bshad/ de'i rjes su byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ na mo rat+na nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ gyis bar bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bzla bzhin du/ dri bzang gi chus slob ma'i mgo la bsangs gtor bya zhing*/ yang mgo la lag pas tham ste/ oṃ a mṛ te huṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun bzla'o/ /yang byugs spos kyis bkus pa'i lag pa mgo la bzhag ste/ thabs sbyor lan bdun zla bar yang bshad/ yang de bzhin du rigs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba yi ge gcig pa/

bh+rūṃ brgya tsam bzlas shing*/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor lan gsum bzlas pas kyang byin gyis rlabs/ de nyid brtan zhing srung ba'i don du/ oṃṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā/ zhes pas bsangs gtor dang bram par byed cing spos kyis bdug go /so shing gi dmigs pa spyi dang 'dra/ dzi na dzi ka gis gtad la/ bh+rūṃ/ zhes dor bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma'i lag tu dri bzang gi chu blugs la/ nye reg byed du bcug ṣ+toṃ bhan+dha dang*/ oṃ hu lu hu lu tsaṇ+ḍa li ma taṃ gi swāhā/ mang du bzlas pa'i khyor chu lan gsum sngags de nyid kyis sbyin pa'am/ yang na/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha= sogs spyi dang mthun par byin kyang rung bar mngon no/ /sngags de rgyud sde gong ma'i khyad chos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med cing*/ bya rgyud la mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang ci yang med pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig de nas chu gzhan zhig gis kha bkru bar 'dod kyang lag len la mi mdzad la/ de nas las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i rtsa ku sha sngas dang gtan gyi don du sbyin/ spyi rgyud las skabs 'dir srung skud sbyin pa'i gsal kha med kyang*/ sngar sa sbyangs ba'i skabs su srung skud byed par gsungs pa de yang slob ma la 'dogs rgyu yin pa'i skabs der btags pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la/ der ma btags na 'dir 'dogs dgos so/ /de nas/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung*/ zhes sogs dang*/ skar ma rab rib mar me dang*/ /sgyu ma zil ba chu bur dang*/ /rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu/ /'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ / zhes pa nas/ 'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skye// zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ chags bral dang ldan pa'i chos bshad pa'o/ / de nas/ bu skye sang ni dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*/ /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la legs par smros/ /kye bzhin bzang dag longs la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag byos shig

ces brjod/ phyag 'tshal du bcug la rang gnas su btang ngo*/ /gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rnam rgyal bum pa'am gtso bo'i bum par 'os pa gcig dang*/ khrus bum mam bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dam ma 'grub na bzhi/ las bum gcig ste/ bum pa nyung ba'i phyogs 'dzin na bum pa drug bya'o/ /las bzhi'i dbang skur byed na bum pa rnams kyi phyi rol phyogs bzhir/ shar du rgyas pa/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub du dbang*/ byang du zhi ba'i bum pa rnams bca'/ de dag so so'i kha dog sogs kyi byed las bzhi so so'i lugs su grub na'ang legs/ dbang bskur tsam la spyi dang mthun pas kyang chog la/ las bzhi'i dbang bskur byed kyang*/ bum pa so so ma 'byor na las bum la bsdus pas chog go /de dag legs par bkrus shing gu gul gyis bdugs/ 'bru dang rin po che la sogs pa nang rdzas rnams thog mar blugs/ phyi nas 'bab chu gtsang ma nas blang ba'i chus sum gnyis tsam bkang*/ gtan nam stegs bu gtsang ma la gtso bo'i bum par dbus sam stegs mtho sar bzhag khrus bum rnams stegs bar ma'am zur bzhir bzhag las bum ni stegs dma' ba'i phyogs sam de'i mdun du bzhag dung chos la sogs pa'i snod du dri bzang gi chu la bh+rūṃ brgya rtsa bzlas la mchod yon gyi tshul du dbus kyi bum pa'i steng du bzhag /me tog 'phreng ba'am gzungs thag kyang btags/ na mo rat+na= nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsangs de nas 'di skad ces/ bum pa nang rdzas rgyan dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin gdod nas gnyis chos dang bral ba rang gi rig pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid do/ /de yang rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos zung can/ lha'i chu bo dang nang rdzas kyi gang zhing*/ pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa rnams su gyur/

sangs rgyas dang byang sems sngags kyi lha rnams nye bar bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab par mos te/ dbus kyi bum pa la rig pa'i rgyal po bh+rūṃ brgya stong dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya dang*/ snying po yi ge lnga pa yang nyer gcig sogs ci rigs pa bzla/ khrus bum bzhi las mdun phyogs kyi g.yas g.yon na gnas pa gnyis la/ rigs kyi snying po/ dzi na dzi ka dang*/ rgyab phyogs kyi gnyis la las thams cad pa/ oṃṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā dang*/ las bum la/ na mo rat+na= sogs thabs sbyor gyi sngags ring ba dang*/ 'bring po dang*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ thung ba ste/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gzhan rnams kyi mtshan sngags kyang bzla bar rigs mod kyi/ nges par dgos pa ma yin pas 'dir bzhag go /de nas zhi ba'i bum pa la/ oṃ ru ru= sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags dang*/ rgyas pa'i bum pa la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bh+rūṃ/ zhes pa sangs rgyas rin chen tog gi sngags dang*/ dbang gi bum pa la/ oṃ dzi dzi dzi naṃ ga taṃ ga ya te di na swāhā/ zhes pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags dang*/ mngon sbyod kyi bum pa la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa hūṃ mdzad kyi sngags bzla'o/ /thun mong du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes pa'ang mang du bzla/ mthar/ dzi na dzika lan bdun gyis me tog dkar po dang*/ bh+rūṃ bzlas te mchod yon blugs/ bdud rtsi thabs spyor gyi sngags bzla zhing*/ gu gul la sogs pa bdug pas bdug ste/ sta gon gyi nyin par bum pa'i bya ba de kho nas chog go kha cig bya rgyud kyi bum pa sta gon la/ bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed cing*/ rten la spyan 'dren pa dgos pa'i sgrub byed du/

dze ta ri'i tshe dpag med dang*/ jo bo'i mi 'khrugs pa'i lung 'dren mod kyang de dag bya rgyud la gong ma'i cho ga sbyar ba'i lugs yin pas de'i rgyab rten du mi 'gro zhing bya rgyud rang skad la/ bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa ni nam yang mi dgos la/ bum sgrub 'ga' zhig la bum par lha spyan drangs pa yod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa med par bum pa tsam la brten nas gzungs sgrub byed pa'i tshe/ bum pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dod yin pas/ de'i nang du lha rnams spyan drangs te bzhugs gsol mchod bstod sogs byed pa yin zhing*/ dkyil 'khor med par bum pa rkyang pa la dbang bskur ba ni mi rung zhing*/ dbang bskur byed na bum pa las bzang ba'i dkyil 'khor logs su yon phyin/ bum pa ni dbang rdzas la dgos pa 'ba' zhig yin pas/ bya rgyud rang skad gi dbang bum la lha bskyed mi dgos so/ /dbang gi don tsam du mi dgos kyang bum par lha bskyed du rung ba'i skabs yod phyin cho ga rgyas shing mdzes pa dang*/ byin rlabs che ba'i phyir byed do snyam na/ /byed la rag mod thob thang med pa'i lhag bcos byin rlabs 'byung ba ni dka' 'o/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga la/ thig gdab pa dang dkyil 'khor bri ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar phyogs legs par brtags pa yin na des chog /min na skabs 'dir brtags ste phyogs nges por byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas phyi'i khrus dang*/ gnas su 'jug pa dang*/ bdag srung ba dang*/ phur bus gdab pa dang*/ steng bcing ba dang*/ khor yug bcing ba dang*/ gur 'bubs pa dang*/ mtshams gcod pa rnams sngon du btang*/ bum pa sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bum bzlas kho na bya/ bum pa bskyed pa dang*/ mchod yon 'bul ba sogs yan lag rnams mi dgos/ de lta bu snga dro dang*/ nyin gung dang*/ dgongs ka gsum bya bar bshad kyang*/ ma grub na thun gcig nges par bya'o//
