de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams yid la dran bzhin pas dri bzang gi chus dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bsangs gtor byed cing*/ na mo rat+na= sogs bdud rtsi thabs sbyor dang*/ las thams cad pa mang du bzla/ thig skud tshon sna lnga pa/ dkar dang dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /sngo dang lnga pa nag po ste/ zhes 'byung ba ltar/ srad bu gsar pa dang ldan pa la/ oṃ ṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā/ lan brgya bzlas/ dzi na dzika gis me tog gtor/ spos kyis bdug/dri bzang byugs/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs spyi la mchod dgos pas mchod pa bshams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sogs kyis byin gyis rlabs/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ ra shi ni na ma stu re swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar mchod bstod byas/ byin gyis rlob par gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas thig 'debs te 'dir kha cig zur thig mi 'debs par 'dod pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi dpe sgrogs tsam byas pa las/ don ma go bar zad do/ /de yang spyi rgyud las/ gru bzhi lham par mnyam nas su/ /rgya gram du ni srad bu bre/

/rgya gram thams cad mnyam par mnyam/ /de ltar sras bu gtan la phab/ /ces pa 'di nang gi cha dgu sogs rgya gram du gdab rgyu'i thig mang po yod pa rnams ston pa yin yang*/ khyed dag tshangs thig ston par 'khrul nas thog mar log thig dang*/ de nas tshangs thig 'debs zhes zer ba ni go rim gya tshom du smra zhing tshangs zhes pa'i 'bru ma non pa'i phyir ro/ /des na tshangs zur gyi thig 'debs pa rgyud so so mang po dag las gsal zhing spyi dang 'dra la/ go sla bas gzhir bzhag tu mdzad la/ de rjes logs thig nas brtsams te phyogs skor gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar na tshangs zur gyi thig btab/ slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang du 'dug pas shar gyi logs thig dang*/ slob ma g.yas bskor byas te slob dpon me dang slob ma bden bral du 'dug pas lho'i thigs dang*/ slob ma de nyid dang*/ slob dpon rlung du song bas nub thig dang*/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang thig gdab bo/ /de nas gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi rang lugs ltar na/ rtsa thig gru bzhi de nyid cha gsum re mig dgu byas/ de re re yang*/ gsum gsum du btang ba'i re mig brgyad cu rtsa gcig 'byung la/ de'i dbus ma ni sgo tshad yin zhing*/ sgo tshad de nyid gsum cha lhag pa dang bcas pas zur du bya rjes byas nas dang por thig gnyis gdab la/ nang ma dbus dor/ phyi ma phyed gdab phyi phyed gdab kyi rtsig pa nas mda' yab kyi bar dang*/ tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon du thig 'debs tshul spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ sgo khang rta babs dang bcas pa bya'o/ /rta babs ni gsal kha med pas tshad med du byed pa sogs ji ltar bde ba yin rung*/ snam bu bzhi ma'am/ bcu gcig yin rung sgo tshad gcig ma byas pas legs par mngon no/ /'ga' zhig phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi dgongs pa yin zer nas/ rta babs snam bu lnga par byed pa snying pos dbyen pa dang*/

gzhan dag logs thig gi nang du mda'/ yab chud par 'dod pa sogs ni/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i lugs la yang thig chen brgyad kyi logs thig rtsa thig yin zhing*/ cha bcu drug gi tha ma bskor ba'i thig gru bzhi de thig chen brgyad kyi logs thig ma yin pa go bar gyis shig /blo chen 'ga' la yang 'khrul gzhi byung gda'o/ /de lta na yang thig gi rim pa spyi dang mthun par btab pas 'gal ba med la/ gang ltar yang dam tshig gsum bkod 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor lha lnga kho na byed na sgo rkyang yin yang*/ le'u bcu gsum pa dkyil 'khor chen po'i skabs su/ dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ bar ma sgo gcig nub tu lta ba dang*/ phyi ma sgo gcig byang du lta ba gsungs pas/ sgo gsum sbrag tu byung ba dang*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ spyi 'gro'i dkyil 'khor sgo gsum sbrag la phyi ma gnyis la sgo re re dang*/ nang ma sgo bzhir gsungs pa dang mthun zhing*/ yang spyi rgyud las/ gzhan ni phyogs kyi cha bzhin du/ sgo bzhi sgo mkhyud bcas par bya/ zhes dkyil 'khor chen po'am rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rigs la/ sgo rkyang yin na sgo bzhir nges pa dang*/ yang na thams cad dogs med par/ sgo ni re re bzhin bya yi/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor nges par ni/ rab tu bzang po sgo bzhir bya/ zhes dkyil 'khor dbus ma kho na sgo bzhi dang*/ sgo sbrag gzhan thams cad sgo gcig tu byed pa'i lugs gcig dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyis rim sum rim bzhi rim sogs rim pa mang por byas pa la/ phyi rim gang yin de la ni/ sgo gcig pa dang rgya cher bya/ zhes sgo sbrag nang ma thams cad sgo bzhi pa dang*/ phyi ma kho na sgo gcig par byed par gcig rnams 'dam khar gsungs so/ /'dir ni de dag dang bstun nas gang ltar byas kyang rung mod kyi/ phyis kyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyi phyag len mgrin gcig par mthun pa ltar sgo rkyang ngam sgo sum sbrag gang byed kyang sgo bzhi byed de 'gal ba yang med do/

/de yang dkyil 'khor phyi ma gnyis la rtsig pa'i nang du lha snam re 'don zhing*/ dkyil 'khor nang ma la ni/ dbus su spyi la grags pa dang mthun pa'i brda' sbyar te cha chen gnyis kyi tshad gru bzhi pa gtso bo'i gnas dang*/ de'i phyogs bzhi'i ngos nas rtsig pa'i bar la cha chen gsum 'khor gyi gnas yin te/ lha snam rim pa gsum gyi don no/ /gsum bkod kyi rgyud 'dir dkyil 'khor chung tshad khru lnga par bshad/ de yang rtsa thig gi tshad yin la sgo gsum sbrag tu 'bri na dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i rtsa thig go /sgo sbrag gsum char la rta babs byas kyang rung la/ nang ma gnyis rta babs med pa dang*/ phyi ma rta babs can du byed pa spyi dang mthun pa dang*/ yang phyi ma dang nang ma rta babs can bar ma rta babs dang bral ba'ang rung ngo*/ /dbus kyi gru bzhi'i gnas su slar yang de'i byed kyi tshad kyi dbus su gru bzhi dang*/ de'i nang du zlum por bskor ba'i pad thig bya/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor nang ma'i lha'i gnas gzhan rnams su yang pad+ma cha chung gnyis pa re bya/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol du 'khyams dang rdo ra dang 'od zer 'phreng ba'i thig kyang spyi dang mthun par btab/ spyir ni bya spyod 'di dag tu phyi'i sa gzhi la mtha' gcig tu dbyibs dang mtshan nyid nges med kyang dmigs bsal med pa rnams spyi dang mthun pa bzang ngo*/ /gnyis pa tshon dgye ba ni/ na mo rat+na= sogs bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags drag tu bzla zhing*/ sa gzhi dang yo byad la bsangs gtor bya/ phyi khrus nas mtshams gcod pa'i bar thig gi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi khrus dang srung ba slar yang byas nas/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ sogs kyis phyag byas/ las thams cad pa bzla bzhin du dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa thog mar slob dpon gyis 'bri/ phyis ni slob ma las byed pa rnams kyis 'bri ste/ gzhal yas khang dang gdan dang phyag rgya dgod pa thams cad la/

bh+rūṃ dang*/ dzi na dzika 'ba' zhig brjod pas kyang 'grub ste/ spyi'i cho ga'i lugs so/ /rgyud 'di nyid las dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i skabs su gsungs shing snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de la nges par 'jug pa 'di tsam yin te/ gzhal yas khang 'bri ba na/ dkyil 'khor dbus ma dang bar ma nub sgo nas brtsams te 'bri/ phyi ma byang sgo nas brtsams te 'bri/ sngags ni/ na maḥsarbā bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ a ma la a ma la ha ra gha a nan+tā shā shwa ta sarba dzī na a shī ni/ ma ni ṣa ra da ma ma den+tu/ a di a da raṃ ba ra a graṃ sa ma sarba tā naṃ/ tat+te me badz+ra āñdzā a ra ra/ a sa ma sa ma/ sa man+tā a nan+tā dhār+m+ma te/ kha na kha ni/ mahā bī raṃ/ a tsa le sa ma sa ma a sa ha ma ba le/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ mahā ra gre ke ha ha ha ha/ badz+ra badz+ra aṃ ka me dha ra dha ra/ /hūṃ hūṃ saṃ da laṃ sa ma pā lo a gra bi gra me/ ku ru ku ru ru ru/ /sarba thā sarba hi dz+wa la dz+wa la/ a gre a gri ṇi hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di bzla ba'o/ /mi nus pas tha na bklags pas kyang ngo*/ /dkyil 'khor nang ma'i nyi zla sogs gdan rnams 'god pa na/ na maḥsarba budha bo dhi swatwa naṃ/ a sarba thā sarba twa ṇa ke swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma la/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇaṃ/ sa ma sa ma hūṃ/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a sa ha haṃ maṃ/ zhes pa bzla'o/ /de rjes rgyud nas gsungs pa'i byang chub sems pa'i phyag rgya dgod pa man chad dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i khyad chos yin pas snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la mi 'jug pas na/ spyi rgyud kyi cho gas cho ga shes par bya'o/ /de la tshon gyi rim pa ni/ rtsig pa ni phyi nas dkar nag dmar ser sngo ba ste/ dkyil 'khor nang ma rim pa lnga dang*/ bar pa la dkar ser dmar gsum/ phyi ma la dkar po gcig pu'o/ /dbus kyi gtso bo'i gnas ni/ ljang khu'am sngon po ste sngo nag gcig tu rtsis nas/ lho sngon por byed na dbus ljang khu dang*/

sngo nag tha dad par rtsis nas lho nag por byed na dbus sngon po'o/ /lha snam dang 'khyams rnams shar dkar/ lho sngo'am nag po/ nub dmar/ byang ser ba yin/ dgos pa can gyi dmigs bsal yod na ma gtogs/ 'jig rten gyi phyogs dang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs 'grig pa nges par bya zhing*/ gtso bo yang dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su zhal gzigs pa dgos la/ dbus kyi grub bzhi nang ma la bzhugs khri mtshon byed 'og gzhi sngon po yin na ljang khu dang*/ 'og gzhi ljang khu yin na sngon po la tshon sna tshogs kyis bkra ba/ de'i dbus su dkar po lte bar zla ba la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs dngos gzhag kyang rung*/ yang na gtsug gtor ram rdo rje ser po rtse lnga pa 'bri'o/ /de nas lha snam dang po la gtso bo'i gdan gyi g.yas byang dang g.yon lho ru/ pad+ma'i gdan la g.yas phyogs su lcags kyu ser po dang*/ g.yon phyogs su rdo rje ljang ser ro// lha snam gnyis pa la/ de nas g.yas g.yon tu byed pa'i zur thig dang nye ba la/ rlung du gri gug dang*/ bden bral du me tog 'phreng ba pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /lha snam gsum pa la lho sgo'i thad du be con dkar po dang*/ byang sgo'i thad du zhags pa ser po dang*/ shar sgo'i thad du 'khor lo'i dkar po rnams kyang pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i lha snam la shar gyi g.yas g.yon dang*/ lho'i g.yas g.yon dang*/ nub kyi g.yon dang byang gi g.yon dang*/ byang shar rnams su po ti'i gzugs brnyan re/ nub kyi g.yas dang byang gi g.yas su ral gri re/ shar lhor spyi blugs/ lho nub tu rdo rje/ nub byang du zhags pa/ de rnams ji ltar 'os pa'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i shar gyi dbus su rdo rje/ de'i rgyab tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ shar lhor me thab/ lhor be con/ lho nub tu ral gri /nub tu sbrul zhags/ de'i rgyab tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/

g.yas su bum pa/ nub byang du rlung ras/ byang du dbyug tho/ byang shar du rtse gsum mo/ /sgo bzhir sgo srungs byed na rgyal chen bzhi'i mtshan ma bkod/ 'khor gyi lha'i gdan rnams kha dog mdzes tshon no/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du 'khyams la/ lho phyogs su rigs sngags 'chang gi rgyal po bdun dang*/ shar du dbang phyug chen po dang*/ dka' bzlog ma dang*/ gzhon nu gdong drug /byang du tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug chen po/ nub sgo'i g.yas dang g.yon du dga' bo dang gnyen dga'o/ /lho sgo'i thad du gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma ste/ de rnams la lha mtshan rgyas pa ma grub na/ swa sti ka te dga' 'khyim re bri bar bya'o/ /nus na gdan zlum po re la/ drag po'i phyag rgya rtse gsum rno/ dka' bzlog phyag rgya rtse gsum gdengs/ khyab 'jug gi ni 'khor lo rno/ sde chen gyi ni mdung thung rno/ tshangs pa'i pad+ma yin par bshad/ ces pa ltar dang*/ rig pa'i rgyal po rnams la/ rdo rje rtse gsum kha gcig pa re re bri bar bya'o/ /yang mdor bsdus pa'i gnas skabs su/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i dkyil 'khor la mtshan ma rnams ma bris kyang chog /nang gi yang gtso bo las gzhan rnams gdan du 'god pa'am thig le tsam gyis kyang 'grub bo/ /skabs 'dir sgo sbrag gsum kar sgo bzhir byas na/ phyi ma'i byang sgo dang*/ bar ma dang nang ma'i nub sgo phye ba yin pas/ lha snam dang sgo khang dkyus gcig pa dang*/ gzhan rnams bcad pa mtshon pa'i phyir/ rtsa thig gi steng du re kha dkar po mngon tsam phra mor bri'o/ /de bzhin du sgo mkhyud kyi nang du rdo rje phra mo re yang sgo gleg dang sgo srung ba'i don du 'bri bar bya zhing*/ 'khyams la ri dang ljon shing nags tshal dang*/ mtsho dang me tog la sogs pa zhing khams kyi bkod pa mtshon byed bya'o/ /gal te dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang du byed na dbus kyi cha chen gnyis la/ gtso 'khor lnga po 'god cing*/

lha rnams rim pa gsum du byas pa'i dang po la/ gzhan gyi mi thub pa gnyis dang spyan ma 'god/ gnyis pa la mdzod spu can sogs dang*/ gsum pa la phyogs skyong rnams 'god par bya'o/ / bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ nye reg byas shing gtsang sbra dang ldan pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams/ ze'u kha bcing ba'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin rdzogs par byas pa'am/ mchod pa'i bgegs bsal byin bskyed byin rlabs gsum por/ gzhan rnams tshang bar byas pas kyang rung ngo*/ /mtshams der yo byad dag tshogs par byas shing*/ dkyil 'khor dang yo byad la dmigs nas/ bod gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar zhi bas sbyang ba/ phyed mas sbyang ba/ drag po sbyangs pa ste bgegs sbyangs ba gsum dang*/ til sbyangs kyi sgo nas byur bsal ba yang bya/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bzlas shing bsangs gtor byas la/ rnam par rgyal ba gtso bo'i bum pa ni/ dbus kyi gtso bo'i gnas las cung zad rgyab gyis phyogs par mañdzi la sogs pa'i steng du yi ge brgya pa dang bh+ruṃ bzla bzhin du 'jog ste dbang gi bum pa'o/ /'di nas bzung ste rjes chog gi bar du bum pa 'di ni mi bsgul lo/ /de bzhin du 'khrus bum rnams ni/ rigs kyi snying po kho na'am/ sta gon gyi skabs su gang bzlas pa de nyid 'don bzhin du dkyil 'khor bar ma'i gnas su 'jog ste/ mdun gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis dkyil 'khor nang ma'i rlung srin gyi grwa dang*/ rgyab kyi g.yon g.yas gnyis me dbang gi grwa la bzhag go /oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis las bum dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i shar sgor bzhag go/ gal te gnas de dag tu 'jog stabs mi bde na/ de dag tu stangs ka tsam byas nas/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i nub sgo'i thad tsam du dbang bum dang*/ de'i g.yon du las bum dang*/ zur thig gi thad du khrus bum bzhag go /bum pa gsum las/ ma 'byor na/ nub sgo'i g.yas su khrus bum bzhag

/ spros pa la dga' na/ khrus bum brgyad sgo mtshams brgyad du bca'/ las bzhi'i bum pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i phyogs bzhi'am/ yang zhi ba byang shar/ rgyas pa la shar lho/ mngon spyod lho nub/ dbang nub byang du bzhag go /'dir 'khrul bum dang bkra shis kyi bum pa don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/ /phyi rol khor ra khor yug tu mchod yon gyi snod sna tshogs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ rma bya'i mdongs dang*/ spos phor rnams brgyad brgyad dang*/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ mchod pa'i rta babs bzhi yang rtsigs par bya'o/ /spyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur phyir ni 'bring po gcig /ces 'byung ba'i 'bring po ni dbus ma'i don yin pas dbang bum yin la/ grwa dang sgo ni ma lus par/ /bum pa dag kyang bzhag nas ni/ zhes pa khrus bum brgyad dam/ bar sgo tshan por gnyis gnyis shig /khyad par du ni bzhag par bya/ zhes cung zad bsdud pa la khrus bum bzhis chog pa dang*/ bum pa gcig ni phyi sgo yi/ /drung du mngon par bzhag par bya/ zhes pas las bum rnams bstan pa yin no/ /shin tu bsdu na/ khrus bum gyi bya ba las bum gyis byas nas/ bum pa gnyis kyis kyang dbang bskur ba rung ba tsam ni yin no/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus sogs ji ltar rigs pa lha mtshan med pa'i sa stong du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam sogs po ti bzhugs par gsungs kyang 'di la gtso bo'i mdun phyogs ma gtogs de tsam gyi sa stong med la/ gtso bo'i mdun bkag pa'ang mi mdzes na de 'dra nges par dgos pa ma yin no/ /phyi rol shar du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ byang du gser 'od dam pa/ nub tu sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdo/ lhor sdong po bkod pa rnams stegs bu la bzhugs nas/ me tog dang dri spos sogs kyis mchod cing*/ dus dus su gtsang sbra dang ldan pas bklag par bshad do/

/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las ni/ lhor sher phyin/ nub tu zla ba sgron ma/ byang du sdong pos brgyan pa/ shar du gser 'od dam pa/ zhes gsungs te/ 'dir ni de dag las gang byas kyang 'dra'o/ /de nas 'di skad du/

mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad= nas/ nye bar brgyan pa' ོ'i bar gyis bdag gis de kho na nyid bsgom/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas su sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams gyi smon lam gyi mthu las byung ba/ rin po che du ma las grub pa'i zhing khams sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhes pa nas/ snying por seng ge'i khri dang pad+ma'i gdan/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi lha'i gdan bdun dang bcas pa dang*/ steng du rin po che'i bla bre dag kyang skad cig gis byung bar gyur la/ khang bzang dam pa de nyid kyi phyi rol du gzhal yas khang rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang bar pa la yang phyogs bzhir gnyis gnyis dang mtshams bzhir re re ste lha'i gdan bcu gnyis dang*/ gzhal med khang phyi ma'i nang gi lha rnams la lha'i gdan bcu gcig dang*/ de bzhin du sgo dang 'khyams rnams la lha so so'i gdan rnams dang*/ khang bzang dbus ma la phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar nag dmar ser sngo ba'i rtsegs pa rim pa lnga dang*/ bar pa la dkar ser dmar ba ste gsum dang*/ phyi ma la zla ba chu shel ltar dkar ba'i rtsig pa gcig pu'o/ / gtso bo'i gnas kyi gzhi ljang khu/ gzhan dkyil 'khor gsum char la mtshungs par/ phyi nang gi sa gzhi thams cad nub dmar byang ser shar dkar lho sngo thams cad rtsig pa'i steng na/ pha khu ser po dang*/ de'i steng du rin po che'i dra phyed kyi gzhi la rnga yab la sogs pa du ma dpyangs pa/ ba ku la'i 'phreng ba dang steng du rin po che leb kan gyis bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i 'gram na 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang bcas pas phyir rol gyi 'khyams la ri dang ljon shing dang mtsho dang pad+ma la sogs pa me tog sna tshogs dang yid du 'ong ba'i 'dab chags la sogs pas gang ba mchod pa'i khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su mdzes pa/ phyi rol rdo rje rin po che'i lcags ris shin tu bskor ba dang bcas pa/ rab tu gsal zhing mdzes la 'bar ba'i 'od kyi snang bas phyogs kun khyab pa'o/

/na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba thā ung ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod/ de dag ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog rje byams gling pas bsgrigs pa na/ 'dir spyan drangs nas mnyes par byed pa ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dngos yin pa las/ 'di'i lugs su rlom bzhin du dam tshig bskyed pa ni/ cho ga sra bsrer gyur pa dag go zhes bris te/ de la smras pa/ gzhan dag de ltar byed pa la 'gog pa de ni khyed bden te/ bya rgyud rang skad las dam tshig pa bskyed pa med do/ /de lta na yang khyed nyid la shin tu 'gal te/ /dkyil chog de dang sbyor rgyu'i sgrub thabs sogs khyed kyis brtsams pa'i bya rgyud rang lugs yin gsung pa phal che na/ lha drug gi sgo nas bdag bskyed byed pa snang ba/ de bas lhag pa'i dam tshig pa bskyed tshul gyi cho ga ci zhig yod/ mdun skyed la dam tshig pa bskyed pa yang bya rgyud rang rkang gi tshul dang mi mthun pa ta nges pa yin mod/ bdag bskyed kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ de bas kyang ches cher bya rgyud kyi tshul la 'gal tshab che ba yin pa go bar gyis shig /de nas phyag rgya rnams byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ rgyud 'di nyid kyi khyad chos te/ thal mo brdab bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod de/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya thams cad byin gyis rlobs pa'o/ /yang thal mo brdab pa dang bcas te/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ ba ra ba ra/ sarbaṃ sarbaṃ/ sa ma sa ma/ kā ru ṇāṃ kā ru ṇaṃ/ tā ra tā ra/ sa rā sa rā/ āp+dī āp+dī/ a mi taṃ a mi taṃ/ a ti a ti/ bi raṃ bi raṃ/ a tāṃ a tāṃ/ shu raṃ shu raṃ/ ha ha ha ha/ mahā sa ma ya/ na mastā a ma la/ sid+dha da ya ke bh+yaḥ sarba budha bodhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba a nan+ta ma dh+ye bh+yaḥ mahā kā ru ṇa /mā lī nī/ tri sa ma ye/

dz+ra la swāhā/ zhes byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po mtshungs pa med pa lan bdun bzlas pas/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma gnyis kyi phyag rgya thams cad byin gyis rlobs/ de nas lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug par mos la pus mo g.yas pa sa la gtsugs te/ lag tu me tog bzung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di lan nyer gcig brjod par bya'o// na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sa man+ta a mo gha pra ti ha ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a gra a gra ā kar+ṣa ṇi hūṃ/ be gī be gī ni mahā be gī ni/ sarbā m+pa badz+ra su lā nāṃ/ ā kar+ṣa ya hūṃ/ sarba mu dra ga ṇa nāṃ/ tik+te tik+te/ ti ti ti ti/ ta ṭha ta ṭha/ a a nā bri te/ a pra ti ha ta/ a mo gha bu kra me/ sa ma sa ma a ma le mahā me/ a ti a ti/ be ge ba twa ke sa ma ya i daṃ/ kā ru ṇa shrī tī na ya/ ta twa ad+gi ni/ ā na ya shī gh+raṃ ta thā ga ta ad+gu shī swāhā/ zha ེ sa pa ste/ mthar me tog nam mkha' la dor bar bya'o/ /'di dam tshig gsum bkod nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de nas spyi khyab kyi cho gas spyan 'dren pa ni/ gong bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa rnams dran par byas te/ bh+rūṃ bdun/ dzi na dzika bdun/ oṃ ṣ+toṃ ban+dha swāhā/ gsum/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya= gsum/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ zhes sogs dang*/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ ces sogs dang*/ las byed pa'i mchod yon bsgreng zhing*/ dad pa dang ni/ nas/ dgyes par mdzod/ bh+rūṃ bdun la sogs pa dang*/ dzi na dzika bdun la sogs pa dang*/ oṃ ru ru= sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags bdun la sogs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang yi ge lnga pa lan bdun dang*/ oṃ mu ni mu ni= sogs lan mang du brjod cing*/ mthar/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka shākya mu ni tri sa ma ya rā dza maṇ+ḍa la de ba tā sa pā ri wā ra e h+yai hi/

lan gsum/ 'dir yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i lcags kyu'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ bcom ldan thugs rje= nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la blta ba/ zhes brjod de/ snying po rtsa ba'i lha lnga gsal btab/ lha snam phyi ma'i lho sgo'i thad du/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ byang sgo'i thad du khro mo gzhan gyis mi thub ma ser mo/ /zhags pa 'dzin zheng*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i khro mo'o/ /shar sgo'i thad du rigs pa'i rgyal mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon gdan la brten pa/ rigs sngags kyi lha mo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i lha snam la/ shar gyi g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' mdzod spu can/ g.yon du mdung thung can/ lho'i g.yas su 'khor los bsgyur ba cher 'byung*/ g.yon du yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ nub kyi g.yon du mthu chen thob pa/ byang gi g.yon du don thams cad grub pa/ byang shar du dri ma med pa'i blo gros/ de rnams g.yas shing thog dang*/ g.yon po ti 'dzin pa/ nub kyi g.yas su 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i phyag gi mthil las g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i ut+pal sdong bu la ral gri dang po tis mtshan pa/ byang gi g.yas su nam mkha'i snying po/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ral gris mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa/ shar lhor 'phags pa byams pa spyi blugs dang klu shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ de thams cad gser btso ma lta bu'i mdog can no/ / 'dir gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bcu gnyis 'god par bshad kyang ha cang mang par 'gyur bas na/ de rnams kyi gtso bo'i phyir byams pa nyid kyis chog go /lho nub tu rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo mā ma kī/

sku mdog sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon gdan la brten pa/ nub byang du mngag gzhugs brtson 'grus chen po dkar po zhags pa 'dzin pa rol pa'i khro bo'o/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha snam la/ shar du brgya byin dmar ser glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de'i rgyab tu nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la zhon zhing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa me thab 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ de'i rgyab tu zla ba dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa ku mu ta 'dzin pa/ g.yas su sa'i lha mo pad+ma'i dbus na lus phyed phyur ba'am/ phag la chibs pa bum pa bsnams pa nub byang du rlung lha ljang khu ri dwags la zhon pa rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ 'dir rgyal mtshan zhes pa ni da lta'i sbubs can 'di ma yin gyi/ ba dan dang gcig ste tog dang bcas pa'o/ / byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang sgo bzhi pa la sgo srungs byed na/ shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po rgyud mang 'dzin pa/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub sgo spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos bu ser po be con dang ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa'o/ / phyi'i gzhal yas khang sgo gcig pa'am/ sgo bzhi gang byed kyang sgo skyong nges par dgos pa ni min no/ / nub sgo'i g.yas g.yon du klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang gnyen dga' bo dkar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ sbrul 'jug yod pa nor bu rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /lho sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol du gnod sbyin ma 'phrog ma ser mo chang bus gang ba'i snod dang ne'u le'i rkyal ba 'dzin pa/

bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa'o/ /de bzhin du drag po dbang phyug chen po dang*/ gangs ri'i bu mo dbu ma dang*/ gzhon nu gdong drug dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ rigs sngags 'chang gi rgyal po glang po che dang*/ yan lag bkra bas byin dang*/ rtse bran can dang*/ g.yon phyogs cod pan dang*/ mig bzang po dang*/ sna tshogs 'od dang*/ legs par sgrub pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor du 'du bar 'os pa'i lha thams cad kyang bzhugs shing*/ phyogs thams cad du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal dang*/ lha'i mchog rnams kyis yongs su bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ de nas/ shāṃ ka re sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes pa nas brtsams te/ bdag la grub pa'i mchog stsol cig / ces pa'i bar dam la bzhag pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ bshags pa dang*/ yi rang dang*/ gsol gdab dang*/ sems bskyed dang*/ tshad med bzhi sgom pa dang*/ yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa'i bar rnams bsnyen pa'i skabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin byas pa kho nas kyang dgos don thams cad 'grub la/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na mchod yon gyi skabs su/ las kyi rdo rje bzed zhal kyi nang du mchod yon bsgreng zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ rig pa'i rgyal po dang*/ rigs kyi snying po mang du bzla zhing*/ lha rnams kyi mtshan sngags lan gsum gsum gyis phyogs mtshams brgyad dam phyogs bzhi'am/ nub sgo'i thad nas shar du phyogs pas 'bul bar bya'o/ /khrus gsol gyi skabs su/ phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad dang yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i shis brjod sogs kyang bya zhing*/ de bzhin du/ mchod yon phal cher/ sogs dang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ 'dod yon lnga dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang*/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa sogs kyang ji ltar skabs su bab pa de ltar sbyar bar bya la/

bstod pa dkyus kyi mthar yang*/ skyes bu ma skyes khyod 'tshal/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /spyod pa'i don kun grub mdzad pa/ /skyes bu gtso bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phung khrol thams cad bzlog pa po/ /skyes bu seṅge khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ngan 'gro thams cad 'joms mdzad pa/ /skyes bu dpa' bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bsod nams dri ni mtha' yas pa/ /skyes bu pad dkar khyod phyag 'tshal/ /srid gsum 'dam rdzab rnams sbyong ba/ /skyes bu pad+ma khyod phyag 'tshal// sdug bsngal kun la rnams grol ba/ /skyes bu rnam grol khyod phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu zhi zhing legs zhi mdzad/ /zhi ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags kyi spyod don kun sgrub pa/ /sgrub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis kun kyi bkra shis pa// bkra shis khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams thams cad thugs chud pa/ / sangs rgyas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams thams cad spros pa med/ /de bzhin nyid de yi ge a'i/ /rjes zhugs rab tu ston mdzad pa/ /de bzhin gshegs khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes dang shes bya'i dngos kun dang*/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas theg gsum/ /lam la rab 'jog rab gnas pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ /gser gyi mdog can mtshan dpes spras/ /na bza' chos gos ngur smrig bsnams/ /chos 'chad phyag rgya mdzad la 'dud/ /'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ gser mdog ral pa'i cod pan can/ /gos ser gyon zhing nor bu dang*/ /lcags kyu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags ma rdo rje 'dzin ma yang*/ /yid 'phrog kha dog bla gos ser/ /rdo rje dang bcas thal mo sbyar/ /pus btsugs bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pho nya mtha' yas sku gdog dmar/ khro 'khrug nor bu'i zur phud dang*/ / sbrul dkar mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan/ gri gug zhags pa 'dzin la bstod// mtha' yas ma ni sngo sangs mdog /zur phud gcig pa lang tshor ldan/

/sgeg dang bcas pa gos sngon gyon/ /me tog 'phreng ba 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /gtum mo gdol ma gzhan mi thub/ /dngos grub kun stsol sangs rgyas spyan/ /grub pa'i lha mchog rnams la 'dud/ /rgyal sras kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal byams pa ste/ /thabs mkhas mchog gyur la phyag 'tshal/ /'phags mchog nam mkha'i snying po sogs/ /rig rgyal byang sems dpa' rnams dang*/ /mā ma kī dang brtson 'grus che/ /zhi zhing srung mdzad gtso la 'dud/ /dbang po zla ba nyi ma sogs/ /nges pa nyid du rnam dag kyang*/ /thugs rjes thabs kyi sku sprul pa/ / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la 'dud/ /klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la mngon dga' zhing*/ /mthu chen ldan pa rnams la'ang 'dud/ / stobs chen lha rnams thams cad dang*/ /sngags 'dzin rgyal po thams cad dang*/ /sa gsum gnas na dge ba can/ /dkyil 'khor gnas pa kun la 'dud/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can kun/ /sgrib spangs yon tan kun rdzogs te/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang mnyam par shog

/ de nas slar yang mchod yon dang*/ nyer spyod sngags tsam gyis phul la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ a ta bhu ti= zhes pa nas/ dzi na dzika lan gsum gyis mgo bor bh+rūṃ yig byung bar bsams pa'i bar bzlas pa byed tshul yang phal cher bsnyen pa'i skabs dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang 'dir khyad par ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi bzlas pa song ba'i mtshams su bum pa rnams kyi bzlas pa ste/ dbang bum la bh+rūṃ dang*/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ yi ge lnga pa rnams bzla/ khrus bum mdun ma gnyis la/ dzi na dzika dang rgyab zur gyi gnyis la las thams cad pa dang*/ /las bum la bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bzla'o/ /'di nas bzung ste bsangs ba dgos tshad las bum gyis bya ba'o/ /las bzhi'i dbang bskur na yang de'i sngags bzla'o/ /de nas slar yang thal sbyar gyen du kha phyes la mdzub mo cung zad bkug pas/ /rtsa sngags lan gsum dang*/ dzi na dzika lan gsum gyi sa gtso bo dang*/ phyag rgya de dang dzi na dzika kho nas 'khor thams cad la yang lan gsum gsum du rgyas btab bo/ /de'i rjes su zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis lha mnyes par bya zhing*/ zhi ba sngon du song bas rgyas pa bsgrubs na'ang legs la/ zhi ba kho nas kyang nges par 'grub bo/ /bar 'dir 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gtor ma'i rim pa rnams bya ste/ de ltar na rgyas btab sbyin sreg gtor ma gsum po ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i yan lag yin par shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa dbang bskur ba la/ /slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba de dag las/ sbyin sreg dang dbang stegs la sogs pa bor te/ gzhan lhag ma rnams tshang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bya rgyud spyi lugs la slob ma gcig kho na la cho ga gcig gis dbang bskur gyi/ gnyis phan chod la yo byad gcig dang*/ cho ga gcig gis dbang bskur mi bya bar gsungs la/ dam tshig gsum rgyal gyi rgyud las slob ma lnga man chad la zung min la dus mnyam du dbang bskur du rung bar gsungs te dgos kyi khyad chos yin par sems la/

spyir ni slob ma'i snod gtso bor brtags dgos kyi snod la ci yang mi rtog par grangs tsam kho na la ngal bas ci zhig bya/ rgyud sde 'di las kyang grangs dang mi mthun na mi shes par bshad kyi dbang mi thob par bshad pa ni med do/ /de nas slob ma dbang bskur ba la/ khrus byas bsangs gtor thog ma'i rim/ /gsol btab sems bskyed sdom pa bzung*/ /mig dar bcings nas me tog gtad/ / nang du khrid nas bden stobs brjod/ /me tog 'dor zhing gdod g.yogs dkrol/ /lha ngo bstan zhing rig pa gtad/ / ces don tshan bcu bzhi po'i sdom yid la bzhag nas/ dang po ni slob ma rnams 'khrus byas/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i sgo drung du 'khod/ gnyis pa ni/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags bzla bzhin du bsang chu nas ku shas blangs te bsangs gtor bya/ na mo rat+na= nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ 'di ni byur bsal ba dang bgegs bskrod pa yin/ yang spod chus mgo la bram ste sngags de nyid lan bdun brjod pa ni srung ba yin/ yang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i lag pa slob ma'i mgo la bzhag ste/ oṃ dz+wa la hūṃ/ lan bdun gyis byin rlabs/ yang bh+rūṃ dang las thams cad pas bsangs gtor bya/ gsum pa ni/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad/ 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs kyis spyir gsol ba btab/ lnga pa ni/ srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ zhes sogs sta gon gyi skabs ltar sems bskyed bya/ drug pa ni/ de nas sdom pa bzung ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag 'bul gyi/ thams cad kyis dus thams cad du bdag la rab tu bzung du gsol/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/

thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su skyob par mdzad pa rnams kyis bdag la yongs su skyab tu gsol/ las thams cad grub par bya ba'i phyir/ dam tshig chen po bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos byed du bcug slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces bya ste/ nam mkha' mtha' yas dang mnyam rgyal dbang po/ /sras bcas ma lus kun kyi dam tshig stsol/ /'chi med bsad med sems can skyab pa med/ shin tu brtan pas 'di ltar bya ba nyid/ ces brjod de/ bdag 'bul ba'i sdom pa zhes bya'o/ / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las ni/ bdag 'bul ba'i sdom pa 'di dbang dngos gzhi song nas rjes kyi skabs na yod la/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyud las skabs 'dir bshad do/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud la kha skong mi byed na bdag 'bul ba 'di mi dgos la/ sems bskyed nyid sdom pa bzung ba'o/ / bdun pa ni/ de nas las thams cad pa dang*/ bh+rūṃ gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i gdong g.yogs bcings/ brgyad pa ni/ slob ma dam rgya 'ching du bcug pa'i lag tu dzi na dzika zhes brjod cing me tog gtad do/ /yang na de'i steng du mig dar dang me tog gi sngags spyi dang 'dra bas kha bskang kyang rung ngo*/ /dgu pa ni yang dzi na dzi ka bzla bzhin gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya bcings/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'am/ yol ba'i nang du khrid/ bcu pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /dam tshig gsum bkod dkyil 'khor mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /lha rnams rim bzhin 'bab par shog /'di la bsod nams mthu yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog / bcu gcig pa ni/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes me tog dor/

bcu gnyis pa ni/ las thams cad pa bzla bzhin du mig dar dkrol/ yang na mig dar dgrol ba la/ tshigs bcad dang sngags spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa'i tshab tu/ de bzhin gshegs kun= zhes 'don pa spos pas kyang rung bar ni mngon no/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ de nas lha ngo ston to/ / de yang 'di na bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pa yin te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi mthu las byung ba/ zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i 'od kyi snang bas phyogs kun khyab pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs ltar dang*/ dbus kyi pad+ma chen po'i steng gi= zhes pa nas/ tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ lha snam nang ma la bcom ldan 'das kyi bzhugs khri'i g.yas logs su/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /lha rnam gnyis pa la rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i mdun ngos 'og phyogs su/ zhes pa nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la blta ba'o/ /lha snam phyi ma'i lho sgo'i thad du= zhes pa nas/ yongs su bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ zha ེ sa pa'i bar du dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs bzhin no/ / me tog gang la phog pa'i lha ngos 'dzin pa ni/ deng sang lag len mi byed pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid las der mos pa byas la/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /sngags dang rig pas byin gyis rlabs/ /'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kyang*/ /thams cad khyod la mngon du 'gyur/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/ /gsang sngags dag la'ang brtson par gyis/ zhes brjod/ bcu bzhi pa ni/ de nas slob mas/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ zhes sogs sho lo ka gsum dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ zhes bzla bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal nas me tog gtor/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/

slob dpon gyis me tog blangs te/ sngar dang por phul ba'i me tog de dang lhan cig tu dzi na dzika dang bh+rūṃ bzla bzhin pas spyi bor bzhag go /gnyis pa dbang dngos gzhi la/ /rim pa bcu drug yod de/ /1gsol dang 2sbyin sreg 3las bum dbang*/ /4dbang stegs 5shis brjod 6khrus bum dang*/ /7rnam rgyal chu blangs 8sngags bzlas nas/ /9skor dang 10gsol 'debs 11bkra shis brjod/ /12rnam rgyal 13bum pa las bzhir bcas/ /14cod pan 15mchod dang 16ched brjod bya/ /ces so/ /dang po ni/ skabs 'dir slob mas yon dbul bar gsungs pa'i don la spyi dang mthun par maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ slob dpon gyis bdag la dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa ni/ skabs 'dir 'grub na nges par zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ gsum pa ni mthar/ thab kyi lha rnams thab nas gshegs te dkyil 'khor la spyan drangs zin pa na/ las bum blangs la bdud rtsi thabs sbyor ring ba'am 'bring po bzla bzhin du/ bsangs gtor byas shing*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla bzhin du/ mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs sogs kyi mthar/ las bum gyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur te thung du bcug /bzhi pa ni de nas slob ma re re bzhin dbang stegs dngos su bca' thub na legs/ min na gcig la bca' ba'am/ mos pa tsam gyis kyang rung mod/ de la dbang stegs ni chu tshon nam rdul tshon dkar pos stegs bu gru bzhi'i zur la rdo rje rtse gsum phyed pas mtshan pa/ dbus su pad+ma dkar po'am sna tshogs pad+ma 'bri/ 'dab ma brgyad pa la bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa bya/ tshad ni rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyed tsam zer yang*/ slob ma'i lus dang 'tsham pa yin pas nges pa med do/ /'dir sgo nub bam byang du gtad ces 'ga' zhig 'dod kyang nges par sgo can du 'bri dgos pa ni min la/

ci ste sgo can du byed na/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub sgo dang 'jig rten nub phyogs la gtso bo zhal gzigs pa nyid kyi phyir/ gtso bo'i mdun phyogs su byed na sgo shar bstan du rigs la/ debs mtshon pa'i shar nas nub tu bstan dang*/ lho nas byang bstan du yang rung zhing*/ drag po'i las kyi dbang la byang nas lhor yang bstan no/ /slob ma'i phyogs la gtso bo'i mdun rgyab gang bstan yang rung mod kyi/ slob ma gtso bo la rgyab kyis phyogs pa ni mi rung la/ dbang stegs kyi sgo las rgyab ston pa yang mi mdzes so/ /lnga pa ni de nas slob ma dbang stegs la bkod/ khrus bum bzhi dbang stegs kyi grwa bzhir bzhag /steng du gdugs dkar po bzung*/ mtha' skor du rnga yab la sogs pa mchod pa sna tshogs ky-is bskor te/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ sogs shis brjod kyi mthar rol mo'i sgra cher bya/ drug pa khrus bum gyi dbang ni/ de nas khrum bum mdun ma gnyis dzi na dzika dang*/ rgyab ma gnyis oṃ ṣ+toṃ= gis dbang bskur te/ bum pa bzhi char gyis rim bzhin dbang bskur rgyu yin la/ /mi nus na gcig tu sdoms te dbang bskur kyang rung ngo*/ /'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ sngags gnyis po lan gsum las mi nyung bar bzlas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod de/ chu 'khyor ba gsum tsam gyis khrus byar bzhug /slob dpon gyi dbang dngos la khrus bum gyi bya ba de kho nas chog kyang*/ bgegs gzhom pa'i dbang byed pa la de'i khyad chos rnams kyang thob na legs pas slob dpon gyi dbang yin yang skabs 'dir/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru swāhā/ la sogs pa bkru byab srung gsum spyi dang mthun par byas na shin tu legs so/ /bdun pa rnam rgyal las bum chu blang ba ni/ de nas dung chos sogs ar+gha ཾ 'i snod dam bum pa gzhan du dbus kyi rnam rgyal bum pa las chu gcus te blugs/

de'i tshe dzi na dzika dang/ bh+rūṃ mang du brjod/ brgyad pa bum chu la sngags bzla ba ni/ bum chu de la snying po yi ge brgya pa lan bdun sogs ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ yi ge lnga pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o/ /dgu pa bskor ba dang bcu pa gsol btab ni/ de nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ de lag tu thogs nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byed cing*/ slob dpon gyis/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud dag par mdzad du gsol/ byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rol mo bzhag ste slob ma rnams kyis thos par yang lan gcig gsol ba gdab/ spyi rgyud las 'di yid kyis gsol ba 'debs pa kho na bshad kyang*/ lag len la tshig gis gsol ba 'debs pa/ slob ma dang ba bskyed pa dang*/ cho ga mi chad pa dang dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /bcu gcig pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga'i thob thang dngos la/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa= sogs shis brjod kho nas chog la/ slob dpon du gyur nas gzhal la 'byor ba thob pa'i dbang byed na/ dbang de'i khyad chos rnams kyang thob na bzang bas bkra shis rdzas brgyad bshams re re bzhin las thams cad pa'am thabs sbyor bzlas pas bsangs/ bh+rūṃ dang*/ dzi na dzika gsum gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs nas/ slob ma la me tog dkar po dang 'bras yos sogs thor bzhin du rol mo'i sgra ci rigs pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' pa= sogs dang*/ 'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lha yis bskor ba'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skyes dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum+ba'i tshal/ /lha mang dag gis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na/

/srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis= /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du// lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas btsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chu gtor ba yi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmang du grags pa chen po lha yis mngon bstod pa// bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing*/ /beḍūr+ya ltar sngon po'i rtsa bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= chu bo'i 'gram na tsar ṣa'i 'phreng gis yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul tshe sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/

/bkra shis= sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis= grong khyer wa ra na sir drang srongs mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang*/ /lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis= bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis= mu stegs byed pa kun kyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang*/ /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa'i rgyal po'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis= 'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*/ bkra shis= de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mchog tu nyer gshegs ba/ /man+dha ra yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod nas/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang*/ bkra shis= lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang po'i mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /nyin mo bde legs= nas/ deng 'dir stsol/ zhes shis brjod rgyas par byed la/ shin tu spros pa la dga' na/ thog mar bkra shis rdzas brgyad tshigs bcad tshig lhug yongs su grags pa dang rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad dam/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi tshigs bcad spyi dang mthun par brjod cing*/ so so'i gzugs brnyan bris sam 'bur du dod pa slob ma la gtad/ de rjes thams cad mdun du bstan nas/ oṃ phun sum= sogs shis brjod rgyas pa byed pa yin no/

/dbang rdzas dang bcas pa'i shis brjod kyi spros ba 'di 'byor ba'i don gyi dbang la nges par dgos pa yin no/ /bcu gnyis pa rnam rgyal bum pas dbang bskur ba ni/ spyi sngags dzi na dzi ka lan bdun dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ snying po yi ge brgya pa nyid bzla bzhin du dang por yal 'dab kyi bum chu blangs la slob ma'i lus la gtor/ de nas bum pa'am mchod yon gyi snod spyi bor bzhag /spyi bo nas bkru zhing mthar 'thung du bzhug go /chu dbang bskur ba'i spyi'i sngags 'di yang brjod de/ san dhā ra ṇa/ un dhā ra ṇi si pra tiṣ+ṭha ta/ su ta ma/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha ta/ bi dza ya ba la/ swa bhā wa/ pra te dz+nyā/ a ro ha/ dz+nyā na ba ti/ ud pa da ni/ dī na a ma la a bhi ṣiñtsi mi/ a bha bh+ya ha ra shu bhaṃ ba ṭi/ a ni shi ta ba hū kum+ba/ a bhi ba tsaḥ zhes pa'ang brjod de chu'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /spyir slob dpon gyi dbang tsam la chu dbang gi skabs su de tsam gyis chog go /bcu gsum pa las bzhi'i bum pas dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga dngos yin yang sngags sgrub pa'i dbang gi rigs 'ga' zhig la dgos pas/ gzhan la sbyin pa'i don du slob dpon gyi 'os des kyang dang por thob na legs pas sngar las sgrub pa'i don du las bzhi'i bum pa bcas yod na/ de dag gis kyang dbang bskur te/ 'di ni khrus mchog= sogs la 'don pa spos te/ ci 'dod sogs kyi tshab tu/ zhi ba'i las kun stsol bar mdzod/ oṃ ru ru= sogs dang*/ rgyas pa'i las kun= zhes dang*/ tad+ya thā oṃ bhūṃ/ dbang gi las kun= zhes dang / oṃ dzi dzi= sogs dang*/ mngon spyod las kun= zhes dang*/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags re bum pa bzhi po de dag gis rim pa can du dbang bskur ro/ /spyi rgyud dngos bstan gyi dgongs pa ni/ /re zhig dngos grub chen po don du mi gnyer bar 'phrin las bzhi re don gnyer tsam la rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dbang mi bskur bar/

las bzhi'i bum pa 'di dag las gang 'dod pa dang mthun pa re res dbang bskur ba yin kyang*/ 'dir slob dpon gyi gnas thob pas rang nyid kyis las bzhi ka sgrub dgos pa'ang yin la/ gzhan la'ang bzhi'i dbang bskur dgos pa yin pas/ dngos su slob dpon kyi dbang yin yang*/ skabs 'dir las bzhi'i chu dbang de byed pa legs so/ /spyir slob dpon gyi dbang du 'gyur ba tsam la gtso bum gyi chu dbang bskur ba nyid kyis chog gi bum pa gzhan rnams kyis dbang bskur med kyang chog pa'i skabs yod do/ /bcu bzhi pa cod pan gyi dbang ni/ slob dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs spyi'i dam rgya bcas/ slob ma'i spyi bor gtugs te/ oṃ ta thā ga ta ud bha wa swāhā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ de ni spyi rgyud kyi cho ga'i lugs yin la/ rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa ni/ thal mo khong stong du spyar ba spyi bor gtugs la/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ tṛ shi khā a gri na na mastu te/ sa man+ta a da sa man tā/ a gri ku na/ a tsa la/ a gri dhar+m+me bi du na hi kle sha duḥkha dz+wa la na dzā ga twa sar+b+ba su khaṃ da dā hī tsa/ shu tā tre daṃ tre sa ma ye ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod de/ rgyud sde 'dir dbu rgyan skon pa'i dbang ma gsungs/ phyag rgya spyi bor 'jog pa nyid cod pan gyi dbang ngo*/ /bco lnga pa ni/ dri chab me tog bdug spos zhal zas mar me rnams slob ma'i mdun du bshams/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum du brjod de/ slob ma la dga' ston gyi tshul du bster ro// yang na gong du shis brjod rgyas pa tshig tsam gyis byas nas/ rdzas brgyad sogs dang 'brel ba'i shis brjod ni bar 'dis byas kyang rung ngo*/ /bcu drug pa ni/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /blo dang ldan pas dbang bskur ro/ / zhes brjod cing*/ spyi bor me tog dkar po 'jog te/ mchod pa dang ched brjod de gnyis po de dag ni chu cod ky-i yan lag ste de yan chad dbang gi dngos gzhi'o/

/dbang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i cho ga la brgyad de/ gsol btab bka' bsgo nyes pa sbyangs/ /rgyal bstan rjes gnang yon blang zhing*/ / dam tshig bsgrags la gdams ngag 'bog / dang po ni/ rtsa sngags yi ge brgya pas tshangs skud mchod phyir thog sbyin/ de yang sna ma'i me tog gi phreng ba la bshad na'ang bod du mi rnyed cing*/ yang gser skud byed par bshad na'ang dkon par 'gyur bas/ lag len la gdab rgyu sras bu dkar po sum sgril sum skor sne mor mdud pa gsum dang bcas pa'o/ / oṃ ru ru= sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags kyis bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba'i lag gdub spyin/ slob ma thal mo sbyor du bcug la/ spyi bor gdugs bzung zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor lan gsum byed du 'jug /de nas 'jug pa'i sgo phyogs nas phyag 'tshal du bcugs la/ bla mas/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gdung 'tshob pa'i don dang*/ sems can thams cad la thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las 'jug pa'i don du/ bdag slob dpon/ 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la slob ma 'di 'bul ba lags kyi yongs su bzung bar mdzod la/ thugs brtse bas bka' drin stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ gdugs bzhag la slob ma dbang stegs la bkod de/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la snyid brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud las sbyor/ / zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni slob dpon dang slob ma'i nyes pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba ste/ skabs 'dir ma grub na/ rjes su byas pas kyang rung la/

'on kyang deng sang mi byed pa shas che'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ lugs 'di'i de kho na nyid bstan pa ste/ 'di skad ces brjod do/ / de la phyi rol du lcags ris bskor ba ni gegs mi 'jug pa'i don yin/ sgo sbrag gsum bris yod na/ gzhal yas khang rim pa gsum ni/ dngos grub rab 'bring tha gsum sgrub pa'i don du de dang de ster ba la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams bzhugs pa'i don yin/ zhes dang*/ gal te rim pa gcig las med na gzhal med khang dam pa 'di ni go 'phang mthon por bgrod cing grub pa chen po dag byung ba'i gnas kyi don yin zhes brjod/ yang gtso bo bcom ldan 'das ni phra mo las bzhi nas brtsams te mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs thams cad kyi gzhir gyur bas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba po yin/ 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa ni rigs kyi bdag po byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin ma ni rigs kyi yum dang*/ khye'u mtha' yas pa ni rigs kyi pho nya dang*/ bu mo mtha' yas pa ni rigs kyi pho nya mo dang*/ lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma ni dngos grub thams cad kyi don du de bzhin gshegs rigs spyi khyab kyi rigs kyi yum dang*/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa pho mo ni rigs kyi khro bo khro mo ste/ 'di thams cad dngos grub mchog gi don du/ so so'i 'phrin las kyi dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir bzhugs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i don yin/ yum mā ma kī ni zhi ba dang srung ba'i don yin/ bran po pho ni gdug pa tshar gcod pa'i don te/ de dag kyang grub pa bar ma stsol ba'i tshul du bzhugs/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams ni grub pa chung ngu stsol pa dang*/ 'dod don sna tshogs pa sgrub pa'i don du rgyal ba sras bcas kyi bka' la stod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin/

gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gyi lha tshogs rnams ni/ dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma ma nges pa stsol bar bzhugs shing*/ las thams cad kyi gdong grogs mdzad pa yin no/ / zhes brjod/ bya rgyud kyi lugs 'dir dgos pa bstan pa'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de nyid brjod pa yin gyi/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgyas bkab mi bya'o/ /skabs 'dir spyi rgyud las phyag rgya chen po'ang ston par gsungs pas/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa tsam dang*/ snang stong zung 'jug gi lha'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul 'chad rgyu yin na'ang dkyus kyi lag len la mi byed pa shas che'o/ /lnga pa ni/ sngags kyi dbang bskur te/ de yang me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i sngags sbyin pa thob thang yin yang deng sang lag len mi byed pas/ 'di ltar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sngags kyi 'phreng ba kha dog dkar po'am/ gser mdog 'od zer 'bar ba g.yas bskor du 'khod pa gsal btab/ /slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa'i bsam pa'i me tog lag tu bzung nas/ bh+rūṃ dang*/ dzi na dzika dang*/ yi ge lnga pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa rnams gsum gsum brjod la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la dmigs su bcug ste/ sngags de rnams kyi rjes bzlos lan gsum gsum bya/ slob mas lha la me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/ bh+rūṃ dang*/ dzin dzika bzla bzhin du/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bor gtor ro/ /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog /'di la rgyas pa 'grub na shog bu la gi hang gur gum sogs kyis sngags bris nas za ma tog tu bcug ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bum pa sogs dang nye bar bzhag /sngar dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i don du de la'ang dmigs nas bzlas brjod byed/

skabs 'dir de blangs nas slob ma klog tu bcug /bzung bar mos nas/ mchog tu grub pa'i gsang sngags 'di khyod kyis khyer cig khyer cig ces brjod/ sngags dbang 'di spyi rgyud las skabs 'dir bshad pa bzhin mtha' bsten gyi tshul du bkod pa yin la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las ni dang por cod pan gyi dbang dang*/ de rjes sngags dbang dang*/ 'jug tu chu dbang bskur bar yang bshad pas/ spyir go rim gcig tu ma nges pa dang*/ sgos su spyi 'gro'i cho ga la yang sngags dbang 'di dbang gi dngos gzhir bsdus kyang legs pa yin la/ de lta na chu dbang gi thog mtha' gang rung du bya'o/ /de yang spyi rgyud las/ rigs sngags rgyal po klog tu gzhug ces sogs kyis 'di bstan pa yin la/ 'jug pa'i skabs su dkyil 'khor der ni rang sngags sam/ snying po sbyin pa des kyang de mnod nas dkyil 'khor gnyis par bzlas/ zhes 'byung ba/ kha cig sngags dbang du 'dod kyang sngags dbang ston byed min/ gong du bshad pa ltar rang lha'i byin gyis rlabs dang ngos bzung ba'i lha dang slob ma spros pa'i don du/ rigs kyi snying po bzla bzhin du me tog spyi bor 'jog pa'i don yin no/ /drug pa ni/ mchod pa gsar pa bshams te slob mas dkyil 'khor la phul bar mos te/ slob ma'i snyim pas me tog 'thor bzhin du mchod yon dang nyer spyod kyi sngags tsam brjod/ spros pa la dga' na/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma= sogs gong gi tshigs bcad rnams brjod kyang legs so// yang skabs 'dir slob dpon la yon 'bul bar bshad kyang*/ deng sang lag len la 'debs mkhan mi 'byung bas/ yon phul bar mos te nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags tsam rjes bzlaus brjod do/ /bdun pa ni/ slob dpon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo tshar gcig ston la// slob mas 'di skad ces brjod de/ /de ring phan chad khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/

/byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /rigs sngags lha tshogs ma lus la/ /dad pa rab tu brtan par bya/ /rtag par theg pa chen po la/ /khyad par du ni mos par bya/ /dam tshig can dang mdza' bo dang*/ / bla ma la yang gus par bya/ /lha rnams kun la sdang mi bya/ /dus mtshams rtag tu mchod pa bya/ /ston pa gzhan gyi gzhungs mi 'chad/ /rtag tu glo bur mgron mchod bya/ /srog chags rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /rab tu brtan pa nye bar bzhag /theg chen la ni dga' rnams kyis/ /bsod nams dag la nan tan bskyed/ /bzlas brjod byed la 'bad pa yis/ /gsang sngags spyod la brtson par bya/ /gsang sngags rgyud las bstan pa yi/ /dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung bar bya/ /dam tshig med pa rnams la ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mi sbyin no/ / gsang sngags rgyud ni legs bsrung zhing*/ /de yang bdag gis rtogs par bya/ / zhes spyi rgyud las 'byung ngo*/ /dam tshig gsum bkod 'di nyid kyi rgyud las/ /tshigs bcad 'di'i dod du/ /yang yang 'chi bar mi 'gyur zhing/ zhes pa nas/ sems can don du smon par byed/

ces pa'i bar du rgyas par gsungs pa 'grub na ches bzang mod kyang*/ da lta'i lag len la spyi rgyud kyi lugs bzhin byar rung phyin 'khyer bde ba dang*/ thams cad du spyi khyab tu 'jug pa'i cho ga shes pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir dkyus su bshad pa nyid bya'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ spyi rgyud las/ de ltar dam tshig bsgos nas ni/ /nyid kyi phyag rgya rnams bstan pa/ /nyid kyi rigs kyi rig pa'ang sbyin/ zhes gsungs pa'i dbang du bya na/ thal mo khong stong bstan te/ 'di ni gtsug tor phyag rgya ste/ dam tshig gsum bkod nyid kyi phyag rgya yin/ gshegs rigs spyi'i dam rgya bstan/ dzi na dzika zhes pa 'di de bzhin gshegs rigs thams cad kyi snying po yin/ de nas yi ge brgya pa dang*/ yi ge lnga pa bton te/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsung bkod kyi sngags te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ye shes las byung ba yin no/ /zhes sngags dang phyag rgya bstan/ deng phyin chad khyed slob dpon du gyur ba yin na/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ slob ma bsdu ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ chos ston pa la sogs pa ni slob dpon gyi las yin no/ / zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar = sogs dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te = sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ drug pa rjes kyi cho ga la/ mchod sbyin bya ba/ rjes bsdu ba'i tshul nyes pa zhi zhing bskang ba'i cho ga ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ slar yang slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la mchod yon rgyas par 'bul zhing lha re re bzhin me tog la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par thams cad 'bul/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du sbyin sreg dang*/ phyi rol tu gtor ma rgya cher sbyin no/ /gong du dbang bskur ba'i rjes 'brangagi skabs su sbyin sreg ma grub kyang sla/ skabs 'dir nges par 'grub par bya/ spyir bya ba'i rgyud ni/

phyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston pa nyid kyi phyir/ mchod pa gtor ma sbyin sreg sogs kyang bshad tshod bzhin skabs de dang der nges par bya zhing*/ de dag kyang ting nge 'dzin tsam la snyad ma btags par rdzas dang cho ga lus ngag gi bya bar thon pa yang yang byed pa gal che ste/ kri ya'i rgyud nyid kyi rang lugs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rjes bsdu ba'i tshul ni/ yang mchod yon dang mchod pa'i sngags kyis mchod pa bsdus pa zhig phul la/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i 'phrin las rnam pa gsum dang dngos grub rnam pa gsum dang byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi bka' drin stsal nas/ mthar thug thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jog par mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs su 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad pa dang*/ sdig pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang*/ 'dod pa'am/ bsam gtan gyi bde ba kha na ma tho ba med pas phyogs kun tu khyab cing rgyas pa dang*/ rnam dkar dge ba chos kyi dga' ston bla na med pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ nad dang 'khrugs pa dang mu ge la sogs pa 'jigs pa dang nyams nga ba thams cad zhi nas/ 'gro ba thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ bdag cag dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la yongs su brten par bgyid pa rnams mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ pha ma dang*/ grogs dang*/ 'khor dang*/ yon bdag dang bcas pa rnams la tshe dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ las kyi rgyud rab 'byams 'grub pa dang*/

rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub gyi tshogs thams cad stsal du gsol/ brtse bas bzung du gsol/ byin gyis rlabs du gsol bdag cag rnams kyi don gyi mchog thams cad 'grub par gyur cig / ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ ma 'byor pa dang = sogs/ lhag pa dang ni/ sogs/ bzod gsol gyi tshigs bcad spyi 'gro rnams bya/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong phyir bskyed/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can= sogs dang*/ gdon mi za bar bdag la yang = zhes pa nas/ ma tang gi swāhā'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi slar gtong ba dang 'dra'o/ /de nas spyi dang mtshungs par lha mtshan yod na dang por bsdu/ gdan tsam yin na logs su bsdu mi dgos so/ /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ ā kā ro 'i sngags las/ nuta pa nan twa tata ces bzla bzhin pas/ rdul tshon dman ma rnams phyags/ bum chu'am dri bzang gi chus thigs rnams kyang bsub/ rdul tshon rgya mtsho chen po la 'bab pa'i chu bor dor ro/ /bya rgyud rang lugs la de tsam kho nas chog kyang klu brgyad cho ga sogs ji ltar 'os pa gzhan nas kha 'gengs sbyar na'ang 'gal ba cher med par sems/ yul phyogs bkra shis pa sogs kyi dgos pa yod na/ cho ga'i yan lag phra mo 'dres kyang cho ga 'khrugs bar mi 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod do/ /gsum pa nyes pa zhi zhing spong ba'i cho ga ni/ de'i phyi de'i nyin par lhag chad 'khrul pa zhi ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /'di yang legs pa'i yan lag yin gyi/ ma 'grub kyang cho ga nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na 'di ni dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i cho ga'i skabs kyi lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la gsang ba spyi rgyud las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba dang*/

dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rnams kyis legs par kha bskang ste brjod pa yin la/ cho ga 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil chog yin mod/ pad+ma'i rigs dang rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spyi 'gro'i lugs kyang 'di kho nas bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur te/ rigs gnyis po de dang de'i rigs pa'i rgyal po dang*/ rigs kyi snying po dang*/ las thams cad pa dang*/ spyi'i dam tshig gi sngags rgya sogs so so'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad cung zad yod pa rnams 'don pa spos shing*/ lha dang sngags dang dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa rang rang gi lugs dang sbyar bas cho ga gzhan rnams 'di kho nas 'grub bo/ /de yang dper mtshon na 'di lta bu ste/ 'dir rigs kyi snying po dzi na dzika gi dod du pad rigs la a ro li ka rdo rje'i rigs la badz+ra dh+ri ka / de bzhin du lag gdub la pad+mas rigs la pad+ma'i sa bon dang*/ rdo rje la ru drā k+ṣa/ spyan 'dren sogs la 'dir sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags yod sar pad rigs la phyag 'tshal sngon du song nas/ mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang*/ /reg pa dang ni dran pa'ang rung*/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams kun kyi gsos grur cig /tad+ya thā/ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe ni ka ṭe ka ṭaṃ/ ka ṭe bha ga ba te bi dza ye swāhā/ zhes gos dkar mo dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs la/ oṃ ku lan/ sogs mā ma ka'i sngags so/ mā ma kī rigs kun la 'jug pa yang bshad do/ / las thams cad pa yang pad rigs la/ na mo mahā shri ya yai/ oṃ sha ma ye sa ma ye/ sau me sid+dhi sid+dhi sā dha ya/ shi be shi baṅka ri a ba ha sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs la bdud rtsi thabs sbyor nyid de 'on kyang thabs sbyor ni rigs gsum ka la 'jug go / steng phyogs bcings pa yang pad rigs la/ oṃ pad+ma ni bha ga ba te/ mo ha ni dza gad+mo ha ya swāhā/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs la

su sid+dhi ka ra ring ba ste/ de ni rigs gsum char la yang ngo*// bsangs byed dang byin rlabs sogs la dgos pa rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo'i sngags ni/ pad rigs la/ oṃ a mṛ ta bha bod+bha ba hūṃ phaṭa ces rta mgrin yi ge bcu pa dang*/ rdor rigs la hūṃ mdzad kyi sngags hūṃ bzhi pa'o/ /bzlas brjod kyi thog mar dgos pa'i byin rlabs skul ba'i spyi sngags rigs pa'i rgyal po'i sngags kyang zer/ rigs kyi bdag po'i sngags zhes kyang bya ba/ bgrang 'phreng byed pa'i sngags la/ 'dir ar+bhu ti sogs kyi dod la/ pad rigs la na mo rat+na tra yā ya= sogs phyag 'tshal gyi rjes su/ oṃ a mṛ ta ga mo shri ye shre ya ni swāhā/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs la phyag 'tshal sngon du songs nas/ oṃ ki ri ki ri rau tri te swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ sngar gyi nor bu 'phreng ba byin rlabs kyi sngags ni/ pad rigs la/ oṃ ba su ma ti shri ye swāhā/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje rigs la/ oṃ badz+ra a dzi taṃ dza ya swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ gzhan yang bza' min zos pa dag byed sogs rnams grangs mi 'dra ba mang du yod do/ /yang don zhags chen mo dang bcu gcig zhal sogs sgos kyi khyad chos mang po can tha na mchod pa'i sngags sogs kyang rgyud so sor mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa rnams la de dang de nges par dgos pa ma yin nam snyam na/ spyir rang rang gi cho ga dmigs bsal yod pa rnams la de dang de byas nas mi gsal ba rnams spyi rgyud nas kha skong ba ni yin no/ /de lta mod kyi rgyud so so phan tshun gnyis kar na tha dad par gsal ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rnams rang rang lugs su mi byed par sgos rgyud gzhan gyis kha skong ba ni shin tu legs pa rang min yang spyir na spyi rgyud ma yin pa rnams nas kyang phan tshun kha 'gengs dgos pa'i rigs ni yod la/ nges par na rang rang so so'i lugs kyi dmigs bsal yod kyang de ma 'grub na sgos rgyud ma yin par spyi rgyud kyi cho ga'i lugs su sgrub ba ni nges par rung ba yin te/

de nas gzhan yang gsang ba'i rgyud/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyi/ /spyi yi cho ga rgyas pa dag /mdor bsdus rab tu bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na byin rlabs dang rgyun yod pa gzhir bzhag la/ tshe 'dir dngos grub thob pa don du gnyer ba yin na/ so so'i thun mong ma yin pa rnams rno khyad che ba yin no/ /de dang de bya rgyud spyi la mi 'jug pas de shes kyang bya rgyud spyi la 'jug pa'i cho ga'i bzhugs tshul bde blag tu go ba dka' la/ spyi rgyud kyi cho ga shes na/ spyi la 'jug pa'i cho ga shes par ma zad/ thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyang*/ mthong ba tsam gyis go sla bar 'gyur bas rgyud don la go ba 'tshol na spyi rgyud kyi cho ga shes pa kho na gal che'o/ /de lta na yang dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyud la le'u bcu gnyis pa kho na nas dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang*/ dbang chog gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i lugs bzhin mi byed pa ci zhe na/ cho ga'i rim pa ni/ de nas bshad pa rnams kyang gong du bshad zin pa 'dir tshang bas de'i lugs nyid yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa de'i lugs bzhin mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la dbang rgyun ma chad par yod cing*/ rgyas pa de la lo paṇa nas brgyud pa'i dbang rgyun med pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyud 'di la 'grel pa dang dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs ma 'gyur bas dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i lha rnams kyi mtshan nyid yid ches can rnyed dka' bas byas kyang rang bzor 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi rgyud thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ bya rgyud rigs drug po thams cad 'chad pa dang sgom pa la dbang ba yin te/ spyi rgyud las de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ gang zhig legs par dbang bskur ba/

/de ni rigs rnams gsum char gyi/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs slob dpon 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ba/ /de ni rigs gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon du ni dbang bskur gyur/ /phyag na rdo rje gzi chen kyi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ba/ /de ni rdo rje rigs gcig gi /dkyil 'khor du ni slob dpon 'gyur/ /ma mo gnod sbyin gsang sngags kyi/ / dkyil 'khor gang dag ci bzhed pa/ /de dag thams cad kun gyis kyang*/ /dogs pa med par bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang rgyud las 'di skad du/ lha'i rigs rnams mthong ba la/ / dbang bskur ba ni rnam pa bzhi/ /bla ma mnyam par bzhag pa yis/ /de dag shes nas ci rigs pa/ / slob dpon go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /dang po yongs su sgrags pa yin/ /rigs sngags rnams ni sgrub pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa legs par bshad pa yin/ /bgegs rnams rab tu gzhom pa'i phyir/ / gsum pa rab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /bzhi pa 'byor pa thob pa'i phyir/ /cho ga rgyas pa de bshad do/ / zhes slob dpon gyi dbang dang*/ sngags sgrub pa'i dbang dang*/ bgegs gzhom pa'i dbang dang*/ 'byor pa thob pa'i dbang ste bzhi'o/ /de dag las gong du zhib mor bstan zin pa ni slob dpon gyi dbang yin zhing*/ sngags sgrub pa'i dbang ni slob ma'i dbang gi ming yin la/ 'di la khyad par ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa la me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i sngags bzlas te chu dbang bskur/ chu dbang ni 'di gcig pus kyang chog la/ las bzhi so so'i 'dod pa yod na/ de dang de'i bum pa'i dbang yang bskur/ rgyas pa la mos na khrus bum dang las bum gyi dbang bskur kyang lhag pa'i skyon med do/ / sbyin sreg gi skabs kyang me tog gang la phog pa'i sngags kho nas 'bul/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ zhes tshig snga phyi gnyis dang*/ da ni dkyil 'khor sogs gsol btab dang bka' bsgo'i skor rnams mi dgos/

rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ gdams ngag 'bogs pa yang mi dgos so// dbang bskur gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis ni/ cha shas kyis na slob ma'i dbang yin mod kyang*/ de'i mtshan nyid rdzogs par ma tshang ba'i phyir/ slob ma'i dbang zhes ming 'dogs mi bya'o/ /'di gnyis la skyabs 'gro ni med du mi rung*/ sems bskyed byed mi byed skabs dang sbyar/ bdag 'bul ba mi dgos shing*/ chu dbang gi las bum dang khrus bum gyis bskur/ bkru byab srung gsum tshang bar bya/ cod pan gyi dbang mi bskur/ sbyin sreg kyang khro bo'i rgyal po kho na la 'bul gyi gzhan la mi dgos/ rjes 'brang gi cho ga gzhan bdun po rnams kyang mi byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa yang de dang 'dra ba las khrus bum kho nas dbang bskur zhing*/ tshig lhag por shin tu bde ba dang legs pa dang*/ bkra shis pa dang rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig / ces pa'i tshig gis dbang bskur zhing*/ bkru byab srung gsum mi dgos pas/ chu dbang gi mjug kho nar bkra shis rdzas brgyad nges par ster dgos la/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs nges par dgos pa ma yin kyang spros pa la dga' na ji ltar rigs pa sbyin te/ shis brjod rgyas par byed pa'o/ /de yang gong slob dpon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bkra shis rdzas brgyad re re la/ bh+rūṃ dang/ dzi na dzika bzlas/ slob ma'i mdun du bstar nas/ bka' las byung bas tshig gi shis brjod cig byas pa kho nas don thams cad 'grub pa yin la/ spros pa la mos na kun la grags pa'i tshigs bcad rnams byas pas kyang legs shing*/ skyon du ni mi 'gyur ba kho na'o/ /de ltar blo la bzhag nas rgyas par ni/ spyi rgyud nyid las rtogs par bya'o/ /da ni sbyin sreg gi cho ga cung zad bshad par bya'o/ /de yang lugs 'di la rgyas pa shar dang zhi ba byang du phyogs par gsungs pa/ skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'brel bas zhi ba'i thab khung dkyil 'khor gyi byang du thab kyi lha rnams zhal dkyil 'khor phyogs la ston/

sbyin sreg byed pa po thab khung dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du 'dug ste/ dkyil 'khor la rgyab bstan zhing thab la mngon du phyogs pas bya/ rgyas pa'i thab khung shar du bca' ba la yang des rigs 'gre/ yang spyi dang mthun par shar du zhi ba dang*/ byang du rgyas pa byas kyang 'gal ba med/ rkos thab dang bris thab kyi tshul spyi dang 'dra la/ yang rgyud las/ las sgrub tsam gyi dngos bstan la mu ran tsam ma gtogs/ kha khyer gsal bar ma gsungs kyang mchu dang kha khyer gnyis kar yod pa legs/ lar rjes mthun gzhan las kha skongs dgos pa rnams sgras zin 'ba' zhig gi rjes su 'brang na dgos don stor pa mang du yong nyen yod pas/ rgyud rkyang la dpe sgrogs tsam gyi nga rgyal mi rung ngo*/ /des na kha khyer la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dam bcu drug /grwa bzhir rdo rje bzhi/ de dag kyang rdul tshon dkar po la bcad dmar ser sngo ljang gang gis btab kyang rung mod zhi rgyas la nag po'i re kha mi bya'o/ /der bud shing rtsig pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ ku sha mtshon byed rtsa'i gdan la g.yas su me lha dang dkyil 'khor lha'i sreg rdzas te sreg rdzas tshar gnyis bsangs chu'am/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ las bum dngos sam bum chu dung phor sogs su blugs pas kyang rung ste de rnams bshams/ g.yon du rigs sngags kyi gzi byin bskyed pa'i dri chab gcig dang*/ mchod yon gnyis dang*/ nyer spyod tshar gnyis rnams bshams/ bsregs blugs byed pa po'i mdun du me yol rtsigs pa'i nang du bgang blugs dang*/ de dang nye ba len stabs bde ba'i phyogs gang yang 'os par mar khu yam shing ku sha la sogs pa bzhag go /de la sreg rdzas ni/ zhi ba la/ sbrang rtsi 'o ma mar 'o thug nas 'bras til dang dur pa lo ma dang bcas pa la sogs pa'o/ /rgyas pa la yang 'o ma dang 'o thug dang zho dang lag pan dang nas chan dang til dkar nag dang sgron shing gi dum bu dang na ga puṣ+pa dang*/

shu ti dang*/ nye shing dang*/ bil ba dang*/ gro dang*/ sran ma la sogs pa'o/ /de lta na yang zhi rgyas gnyis po 'di sreg rdzas gcig gis gcig shos kha bskang pas chog cing*/ shu ti nye shing na ga puṣ+pa gsum da lta bod du grags pa 'di rnams ma yin pas/ de rnams rnyed dka' yang mar dang yam shing 'dzom phyin/ rdzas gzhan rnams gang rnyed kyis chog pa yin no/ /dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tsam rang nyid kyis blangs nas sbyin sreg la 'jug ma 'brel na mi dgos/ zhi ba la pad+ma'i skyil krung dang*/ rgyas pa la bkra shis kyi skyil krung ste bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod/ bsangs chu'am las bum gyi chu la dmigs te/

na mo rat+na= nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar bdud rtsi thabs sbyor lan bdun brjod/ bsangs chu gsar du sgrub dgos na/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin bya/ gzi byin bskyed pa'i dri chab la dmigs te/ na mo lo ka dh+ri tā ya/ oṃ shang ka re/ shan ti ka re/ ghuṭ+ṭa ghuṭ+ṭa ghuṭ+ṭi ni ghā ta ya ghuṭ+ṭi ni swāhā/ oṃ ku lan+dha ri ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mā ma kī 'i rigs sngags dang snying po gnyis nyer gcig sogs mang du bzlas la/ dz+wa la dz+wa lā ya phaṭa/ sid+dhi sā dha ya phaṭa/ di pe di pā ya phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kyang ci rigs par bzlas/ de lta bu'i dri chab kyi mchod rdzas sreg rdzas thams cad la bsangs gtor byas te/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor dang sngags bshad ma thag pa de rnams lan gcig gi mthar/ oṃ gzi brjid ldan pas rdzas nang du/ / phyi bshol ma mdzad bzhugs nas su/ / kun gyi gzi brjid spel ba dang*/ /byin rlabs can du mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra hūṃ dha/ zhes dang*/ dzi na dzika mang du brjod/ rgyud las/ zlos bu dang ni ma 'dres dang*/ /bsnor ba yis kyang ci 'dod pa/ /mkhas pas rdzas kyis byin gyis rlobs/ zhes sngags dang tshigs bcad de rnams mgo thon rkang thon gyi tshul gyis lan mang du brjod par gsungs na yang da lta tshar gsum mam gcig tsam byed/ 'di sreg rdzas mchod rdzas byin rlabs yin/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga 'di sbyin sreg tu ma zad sgrub pa'i skabs kyi mchod rdzas kun la'ang dgos la bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi mchod pa gzi byin bskyed pa la'ang 'di dag byas na legs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas thab kyi shar lho'am/ byang dang shar gang rung du me tshang bcas pa la/ a mṛ te dang dzi na dzika bzla bzhin du me sbar/ mar khu blugs gzar gyis cung zad gcus te blugs la/ gdangs ring pos swāhā dang*/ hā yig ring po lan mang du brjod cing bsgyings pa dang bcas par bya'o/ / oṃ dang*/ bh+rūṃ mang du brjod/

rlung yab kyis g.yabs/ ku sha la sogs pa'i rtsa sngon po'i bam po phyogs mtshams brgyad du spyi dang mthun par bkram/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ag+na ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya swāhā/ me lha'i sngags thung ba dang*/ lag gnyis khu tshur las gung mo sgreng ba'i tshig gsum par mdzub mo'i rtse mo sbyar/ g.yas snying gar phyir bstan/ g.yon dkur bzhag /mthe bong nang du g.yab pa'i spyan drangs/ bsangs chus gtor te las thams cad pa bzlas/ sngags de nyid kyis sreg blugs lan gsum phul/ thabs kyi dbus su drang srong chen po me lha sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyi mchog sbyin dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis dbyig pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gnas pa/ 'khor drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyi bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ke li kī la badz+ra bhi ma rau tri sogs kyis bgegs bsangs/ de nas gong gi sngags dang phyag brgya las mthe bong mdzub mo'i glor bzhag pas dam la bzhag go / oṃ ag+na ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ā di bya ā di bya ya swāhā/ zhes me lha'i sngags ring bas mar dang yam shing dang*/ sngags de nyid dam 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ha ri sogs kyis dkar gsum dang 'bru sna la sogs pa me lnga nyid kyi sreg rdzas rnams rim gyis 'bul/ yang gong bzhin/ oṃ ag+na ye= sogs sngags thung bas bgang blugs lan gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa 'bul/ skabs de dag tu mi bkra ngan pa dag byung na bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags kyis bsang chu gtor bas bzlog par 'gyur la/ /da dung ma bzlog na/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor 'am/ stobs po che gang rung spyan drangs la/ so so'i rang sngags kyi bgang blugs phul bas byur dang bgegs rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro/

/me bkra ngan pa ma byung na de 'dra mi dgos so/ /de rjes/ bdag gi sbyin sreg gi las 'di bgegs med cing 'bras bu'i mchog dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes me lha la gsol ba lan gsum btab/ de nas skabs 'di nyid du 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i me lha la mchod yon nyer spyod gtor ma bgang blugs bstod pa rnams grub nas gshegs gsol byas na bya rgyud rang lugs yin pas cho ga'i rim pa 'di ltar bzang la/ yang skabs 'dir me lha thab kyi zur nang ci bde bar bzhugs/ bar 'dir dkyil 'khor pa mchod/ slar yang me lha'i rjes cho ga byed pa sogs spyi 'gros kyi rigs pa bkab kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de lta na yang rgyud sde gong 'og gi sbyin sreg thams cad la dkyil 'khor pa mchod pa'i tshe/ me lha gug par sdod pa ma yin te/ me nyid dang me lha gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor pa mchod pa'i tshe de yang mchod pa yin no/ kha cig 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ /de tshe me yi snying gar sngags/ /bdun bzlas pa yis rtag par ni/ /me spyan drangs pa rig pa'i bdag /me tog dri ni zhim rnams kyis/ /gnas 'bul ba ni spyan drangs nas/ /rtag tu'o sngags shes mkhas pas so/ / zhes gsungs pa'i don du bsam nas/ me'i lha'i thugs kar dkyil 'khor ba spyan drangs te bzhugs par 'dod pa ni/ rang gi de nyid ston par byed pa ste/ me spyan drangs ngo zhes pa yan chad drang srong me lha spyan 'dren dang*/ rig pa'i bdag cais pa man chad dkyil 'khor pa spyan 'dren gyi tshig yin pa ma go bar snang ba dang*/ me spyan drangs ngo zhes pas dkyil 'khor ba spyan drangs bar go ba ni/ shin tu blun po'i rnam 'gyur yin pas phyir dang*/ me'i snying gar sngags lan bdun bzla zhes pa ni/ me dpung gi dbus su sems gtad nas me lha rang gi sngags lan bdun bzlas te sbyan drangs zhes pa'i don yin pa la/ me lha'i snying gar dkyil 'khor ba spyan 'dren/

zhes par go 'dug ste de ltar na sngags lan bdun gang yin ngos 'dzin rgyu med pa dang*/ me spyan drangs zhes pa dkyil 'khor pa yin na/ spyan drangs nas rtag tu'o zhes pa ni nges par yang dkyil 'khor pa las 'os med pas dkyil 'khor ba lan gnyis spyan 'dren dgos par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /de na 'bar ba'i me'i nang du gnas sam gdan bkod pa la dkyil 'khor ba rnams spyan 'dren pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar bya ste/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba thā ud ga ta s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum gyi lha'i gdan grub par gyur/ de nas bh+rūṃ dang dzi na dzika bdun brjod pa nas brtsams/ yongs su bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad rang rang so so'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ zhes sbrail/ 'di dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshad dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa yin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung nas me tog gi snod blangs te/ 'bru tshom zhig thab nang du 'dor ba sogs bod rnying pa'i lag len bzhin byas kyang rung zhing*/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe 'dir dam bzhag mi dgos te sngar grub pa nyid kyis so/ / dkyil 'khor med na shang ka re nas/ ban+dha swāhā 'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dam bzhag bya/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das nas/ a mṛ ta swāhā/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma= nas/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo= mas bstod pa'i bar mchod bstod kyang bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin no/ /de nas dzi na dzika dang*/ yi ge lnga pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa rnams bzla bzhin du bgang blugs lan gsum la sogs pa phul/ de nas brtsams te yi ge lnga pa'am/ mu ni'i sngags sam/ yig brgya ste gsum po gang rung gcig kho nas/ yam shing la sogs pa'i sreg rdzas gzhan rnams 'bul la/ bgang blugs kyang brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar 'os pa 'bul dgos kyang grangs gcig tu nges pa med do//

yang nges par dgos pa ni min yang 'khor rnams la mtshan sngags kyi sgo nas bgang blugs re tsam phul kyang legs la/ sreg rdzas gzhan rnams ni sgos su 'bul mi dgos so/ /spyir ni gtso bo dang*/ rang sngags kho na la phul bas lha gzhan thams cad kyang tshim par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'khor la sgos kyi 'bul ba med kyang chog go /dbang bskur dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi sbyin sreg yin na/ de'i rjes su slob dpon gyi mdun du slob ma bzhag /slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yon pas/ de'i g.yas kyi mthe bong bzung ba'am/ de'i gos kyi mtha' nas bzung ba lta bus kyang chog /blugs gzar mar gyi bkang la yi ge brgya pa dang*/ na mo lo ka sogs mā ma kā'i sngags bzlas te/ slob ma'i lus la lan gcig bskor nas/ slob ma nyid kyis 'bul du 'jug pa lan bdun bya/ slob ma mang po sogs la de ltar mi nus na mos pa brtan pos dmigs pa sgom du bcug nas slob dpon gyis phul bas chog la/ yang na las kyi rdo rjes bgang blugs bskor kyang rung ba nyid do/ /de nas slob ma la thabs sbyor bzlas pa'i dpung skud bcings/ las sngags kyis snying gar bsangs gtor bya/ slar yang slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la bgang blugs lan gsum 'bul lo// spyin sreg logs su byed pa yin na/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ ma tang gi swā hā 'i bar slar btang ba'i cho ga bsnyen pa'i skabs dang 'dra la/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i skabs ni/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ nai be t+ya swāhā/ dkyil 'khor la me tog dor shing*/ sngar gyi me tog gi snod dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bskyal/ me tog cung zad tsam dkyil 'khor la gtor/ me nang du bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis lha tshogs rnams slar phyir la gshegs te/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas su rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas sreg rdzas kyi lhag ma rnams sreg bzhin du/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ha ri piṅga la lo hi ta ak+ṣa de hi da dā pa ya hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/
