sarba bigh+nan na sha ya swā hā/ zhes pas 'bul zhing*/ mchod yon dang nyer spyod rnams kyang sngags de nyid kho nas 'bul ba'am/ swāhā sa gong du ar+ghaṃ nas/ ā lo ke 'i bar du sbyar ba dang*/ gtor ma yod na ba liṃ sbyar ba rnams kyis kyang phul/ slar yang sngags ring bas bgang blugs bdun phul/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ zhes sogs bstod pa ji ltar 'os pas bstod te/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong phyir bskyed/ oṃ ag+na ye= sogs sngags thung ba'i mthar/ gats+tsha gats+tsha zhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol/ bzhud cig ces ni bdag po'i bka'/ /bzlos pas rab tu bsgrags nas bzhud/ spyan yang drangs ma thag tu ni/ gsang sngags dgyes nas 'byon par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa la/ 'byon par mdzod cig ces bsgyur nas/ gshegs gsol gyi tshig byed pa'ang yod de 'gal ba med par 'dra'o/ /de rjes smon lam dang shis pa brjod do/ /las rjes mi mngon par byed tshul spyi dang 'dra/ 'di ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ste 'di tsam gyis kyang bya/ rgyud rang lugs kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga ji ltar yin pa go bar nus so/ /da ni gtor ma'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /bya rgyud rang lugs la 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor pa la gtor ma ma bshad ces grags pa dang*/ der ma zad kri yo ga sde gsum char du yang ma bshad do zhes grags la/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni rnam grangs du ma zhig gsungs pa yin no/ /de lta na yang spyi rgyud dpung bzangs kyi dngos bstan las/ 'byung po spyi dang phyogs skyong gi gtor ma gnyis gsungs te/ go rim yang de ltar gdon la mchod pa byas nas su/ de nas phyogs skyong rnams la mchod pa bya/ zhes gsungs shing*/ da lta gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba la/ zhes sogs ni/ gnyis po de'i mjug sdom phan yon ston pa yin kyang*/ zur gyis bgegs gtor yang 'phangs par mngon la/ rgyud mang por bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa yang gsungs pas/

spyir bgegs gtor dgos la/ gzungs grwa lnga las rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma'ang gsungs pa ltar de yang 'grub na legs/ khyad par du yang dkyil 'khor gyi sgo srungs la bkod yod na nges par bya/ spyir gtor ma cha gsum po de grub na/ rgyal chen gyi gtor ma ma grub kyang cho ga chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /de rnams chabs gcig tu bshom na rgyal chen dang phyogs skyong gral 'go ma'i stegs bu mtho ba la bzhag /'byung po spyi'i de bar ma dang*/ bgegs gtor sa phyogs dma' ba'am/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi'i sgo drung du bzhag go /phyi rol gtor ma'i tshul du byed na/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i lho nub phyogs thag bsrengs nas/ stegs mtho ba la 'byung po spyi gtor dang*/ dma' ba'i phyogs sam/ sa rjen la bgegs gtor bshams te gtor/ byang shar du thag nye bar stegs bu mtho ba la phyogs skyong gi gtor ma 'jog cing*/ rgyal chen gyi gtor ma'ang phyogs gtor mi byed na de nyid nas gtong ba'am/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyogs nas gtor/ phyogs gtor byed na phyogs bzhi so so nas bshams te gtod/ phyogs skyong bcu la phyogs gtor byed na/ gzhan rnams rang rang gi phyogs dang steng 'og gnyis shar nub thag ring bar skyel lo/ /so so'i dam rdzas kyi skabs su sna tshogs shig yod kyang*/ sgrub mchod sogs spyi gtor gyi skabs 'dir cha gsum la bgegs gtor ma gtogs thams cad dkar gtor du bya/ dbyibs bkod pa deng sang gi lag len spyi dang mthun pas chog /gang ltar yang legs par bshams la gnas gcig tu bshams pa rnams dus gcig tu byin gyis rlabs pas kyang rung*/ gnas so so na yod pa rnams 'bul ba'i gnas skabs so so de nyid du byin rlabs byed dgos so/ /de la byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ yongs su grags pa'i sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis rlabs kyang rung*/

/ yang bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyis bsangs/ oṃ te dza= sogs kyi gzi byin bskyed slar yang bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs/ dzi na dzika gis brtan par byas/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel lo/ /yang na spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga zhib mo las 'byung ba bzhin/ oṃ dz+wa la ba ti rat+na ghā ṭa swā ri ṇi tu ṭi tu ṭi swāhā/ zhes gtor snod byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ ra sā ra sā gra ba ti sarba bid+ya a dhi ṣ+ṭhi te/ saṃ pū ra ya hūṃ/ zhes pas ro bro bar byas/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la s+pha ra pra ra sa ra sa sī dhā ya hūṃ/ zhes rgya cher spel zhing gzi byin bskyed do/ / 'di tsam kyis kyang chog ste/ gtor chog gsal kha med pa'i bya rgyud kyi skabs mang po kha bskang du rung ngo*/ /de ltar na byin rlabs gsum po gang rung cig bya/ de nas bgegs gtor ni/ cha gsum gyi cho ga spyi dang 'dra ba'i bden brdar byas te bgegs rnams gtor ma'i gnas su bkug oṃ gung ka re= sogs la spyi 'gro ltar na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyi mthar/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/

zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas sbyin pa'am/ rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i sgos kyi gtor sngags ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ ba la ba ti ba līn+de swāhā/ zhes pa btags pas sbyin no/ / gang zhing mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ zhes sogs spyi dang mthun par bshad sbyang byas la/ gtor ma ring du gtong ba dang*/ thabs sbyor gyi sngags kyis mtshams bcad nas snying po bzla bzhin du nang du 'ongs la nye reg bya'o/ /de nas 'byung po'i gtor ma ni/ sngon bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ zhes pa nas/ 'dir byon cig ces pa'i bar brjod/ don zhags kyi rgyud las/ 'byung po spyi spyan 'dren pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ di bya lo tsa ni a mo ghe pra wa re sarba bid+ya a dhi ṣ+ṭhi te sid+dhi shud+dha bi lo ki te swāhā/ zhes pa spyan 'dren par bshad kyang pad+ma'i rigs kyi cho ga'i khyad chos yin par sems/ des na skabs 'dir gong gi tshigs bcad nyid rgyud kyi sngags tshig yin pas de tsam gyis chog par mngon la/ de nas/ oṃ de bā ya swāhā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ nā ga dang*/ yak+ṣa dang*/ gan+dhar+bha dang*/ a su ra dang*/ kan+na ra dang*/ ga ru ṭā dang*/ ma ho rā ga dang*/ ma nuṣ+ya dang*/ oṃ a ma nuṣ+ye swāhā/ rnams la gong du bshad pa ltar rgyud 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor sngags btags pa'am/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pas gtor ma 'bul/ de nas mchod pa dang tor ma thams cad lhan cig tu 'bul ba ni/ oṃ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ nas/ rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /'phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa dang*/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul ba/ /'di dag bzhes nas btung zhing bsnams nas su/ /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod swāhā/ lan gsum gyi mthar mchod gtor rnams ring du gtor/ chos rnams gang dag= sogs kyis chos bshad/ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha gats+tsha/

zhes se gol gtogs te gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog thams cad kyi gtso bo yin par shes par bya'o/ /de la thog mar phyag rgya rnams go bar bya ste/ lag gnyis mthe chung bkug pa mthe bos mnan/ sor mo dbus ma gsum brkyang ba/ g.yon snying gar bzhag g.yas dku la bsten pa ni/ dbang po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ de las mdzub mo gnyis g.yab pa ni spyan drangs pa dang*/ mdzub mo gnyis phyir bskyed pa ni/ slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan rnams kyang shes par bya ste/ me lha'i phyag rgya ni sbyin sreg gi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /rdo rje nang bsdams las srin lag gnyis phyir brkyang ba ni/ gshin rje'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste de nyid g.yab cing drag tu bkug pa ni spyan 'dren pa dang*/ dam rgya las mthe bong phyir bskyed pa ni/ gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur las gung mdzub phyir brkyang ba gshibs pa g.yas snying ga dang*/ g.yon dkur bzhag pa ni srin po'i dam rgya ste/ de nyid las g.yon gyi mdzub mo g.yab pa dang*/ phyir bskyed pa yang spyan drangs pa dang gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /khur tshur gnyis kyi mtheb mdzub zhag mig gi tshul du sbyar nas khu tshur snying gar 'jog pa ni chu lha'i phyag rgya ste/ g.yon pa'i 'dzub mo g.yab pa dang*/ phyir bskyed pa yang ngo*/ /lag gnyis khu tshur las/ gung mo bsgreng ba'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo bkug pa'i rtse mo btsugs pa/ g.yon snying ga dang g.yas dkur bsten pa ni/ rlung lha'i phyag rgya yin la/ de las g.yas kyi mthe bong g.yab pa dang*/ phyir bskyed pa yang ngo*// rdo rje nang bsdams las mthe chung gshibs te brkyang pa de srin lag brkyang zhing rtse mor sbyar ba'i nang du bcug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya ste/ de nyid las gung mo brkyang nas g.yas pa dang*/

phyir bskyed pa yang ngo*/ /rdo rje nang bsdams las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo sbyar ba zhes bya ste/ gung mo'i sen mo la mdzub mo reg pa yin la/ mthe bongaganyis so so'i phyogs kyi gung mo la sbyar ba ni/ dbang ldan gyi phyag rgya ste/ de nyid las mdzub mo g.yab pa dang phyir bskyed pa yang ngo*/ /mig steng du phyogs shing thal mo khong stong ni/ tshangs pa'i phyag rgya ste/ de las mdzub mo g.yab pa dang*/ phyi la drag tu brkyang pa yang ngo*/ /skabs 'dir zla ba dang nyi ma ni tshangs pa'i rjes 'brang yin pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya logs pa mi dgos so/ /lag gnyis thal mo khong stong las mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug pa thal mo'i rtse mo mthur du bstan pa ni sa bdag gi phyag rgya yin te/ mig thur du bstan nas mdzub mo gnyis g.yab pa dang*/ de nyid phyir bskyed pa yang ngo*/ /skabs 'dir klu dang lha min yang lha'i rjes 'brang yin pas phyag rgya la sogs pa mi dgos so/ /phyogs gtor du byed na gtor ma bcu bya la/ gzhan ni ji ltar bde ba ste bsdu na gcig gis kyang chog go /gtor ma byin rlabs sgos su dgos mi dgos skabs dang sbyar/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyang dkyus bzhin bya/ na mo badz+ra a s+ya shi badz+ra phā ṇi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ e h+ye haṃ/ dbang po dang*/ oṃ ag+ne ka pi la/ ā ka si la dz+wa la dz+wa la/ da ha da ha shi ṣe to li bi ru pāk+ṣa swāhā/ e h+ye hi/ me lha dang*/ oṃ ya ma ya swāhā/ gshin rje dang*/ oṃ sarba bhu ta bha yaṃ ka ra ku ru ku ru swāhā/ srin po dang*/ oṃ tri tri su tra/ tri tri shi ṣe/ to li bi ru pak+ṣa swāhā/ chu lha dang*/ oṃ shwa sa kha kha khu kha swāhā/ rlung lha dang*/ oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/ gnod sbyin dang*/ oṃ dz+ruṃ dz+ruṃ shi ba swāhā/ dbang ldan dang*/ oṃ ur+dhaṃ bra h+me swāhā/ tshangs pa dang*/ oṃ sur+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye swāhā/

nyi ma dang*/ oṃ tsan+t+ra nak+ṣa tra a ti pa ta ye swāhā/ zla ba dang*/ oṃ adho pri th+wī bh+yaḥswāhā/ sa lha dang*/ oṃ a su re swāhā/ lha ma yin dang*/ oṃ nā ge bh+yaḥswāhā/ klu rnams te de dag re re bzhin yang e h+ye hi zhes btags pa'i sngags dang*/ gong du bshad pa'i spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ ka ma la ya swāhā/ gdan phul/ spro na zhal phyag gi rnam pa gsal 'debs shing ngag tu brjod/ bsdu na yid kyis bsam pas chog sngar gyi sngags la e h+ye hi bor ba re re bzhin lan gsum gsum sngar bshad pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas dam la bzhag /gong du bshad pa'i so so'i sngags sam/ mtshan sngags tsam gyi mthar/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ gan+dhe swāhā/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ne be t+ya a lo ke 'i bar du sbyar/ spyi 'gros kyi lugs ltar na/ sngags re re'i mthar/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags sbyar ba lan gsum gsum gyis 'bul/ dam tshig gsum bkod nyid ltar na/ sngags re re'i mthar thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor sngags sbyar te 'bul/ thams cad kyi thun mong du/ oṃ dbang bdag 'byung po'i bdag por bcas pa yis/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /ma dang srin po gshin rje chu bdag dang*/ /rlung dang lus ngan 'byung po'i mgon dang bcas/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /lha rnams kun dang sa'i klu rnams dang*/ /ri'i lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams kun/ /so so so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas kyang*/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen mdun dang*/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa gtor ma bcas/ /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod swāhā/ shrad+dha ka ra 'i cha gsum gtor chog tu drangs pa rnams dang dpung bzangs snga 'gyur gnyis la 'gyur khyad kho na ma yin pa'i khyad par 'phran tshegs 'dug pa las 'dir rgyud ltar bris pa'o/

/zhes lan gsum/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ zhes sogs kyis bstod/ yang sngags so so'am mtshan sngags sdoms pa'i mthar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de rjes spro na/ chos bshad byas kyang logs la bsdu na ma byas kyang rung ngo*/ /mchod pa rnams mas rim gyis bsdus nas gtor ma'i mgo la blug /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bskyal lo//so so'i sngags gyi mthar/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swā s+thā naṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ gong du bshad pa'i gshegs gsol gyi phyag rgyas rang gi gnas su btang ngo*/ /'di phyogs gtor du byed na/ phyogs re re bzhin gtor ma byin rlabs spyan 'dren gdan 'bul bskyed chog dam la bzhag pa mchod pa gtor ma bstod pa gshegs gsol zhes rim pa de rnams kyi dbye ba so sor phral re/ phyogs tha dad du 'bul lo/ /de las shar gyi rjes su steng dang*/ nub kyi rjes su 'og byed pa ni lag len no/ /de nas rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma ni/ so so'i dam rdzas rnams kyang bshams shing byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ dh+ri ta rāṣ+ta ya swāhā/ e h+ye hi/ yul 'khor srung dang*/ oṃ bi ru dha kā ya swāhā/ e h+ye hi/ 'phags skyes po dang*/ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swāhā/ e h+ye hi/ spyan mi bzang dang*/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇā ya swāhā/ e h+ye hi/ rnam thos bu rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ ka ma la ye swā hā sa gdan phul/ spro na bar 'dir sku'i rnam pa spyi dang mthun par bskyed pa'i tshigs rnams ngag nas brjod/ bsdu na yid kyis bsam pa kho nas chog /thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i phyag rgya kho na bstan te/ so so'i sngags rnams re re bzhin tshar gsum gsum gyis dam la bzhag /mtshan bzhi po sbrel nas 'gor oṃ dang*/ mjug tu swāhā sbyar nas/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar nas/ oṃ gan+dhe swāhā/ la sogs pa nyer spyod phul/ oṃ dh+ri ta raṣ+ta swāhā/ zhes sogs sngags bzhi po re re'i mthar nam mkha' mdzod btags pa'am/

'di nyid las byung ba'i ba la ba ta'i gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum gsum gyi phul/ rol mo dang bcas te/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa= sogs sho lo ka bzhis bstod/ de nas shis par brjod de las bcol byed pa ni 'di skad ces/ phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchog khyod la/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis khyed rnams bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed rnams bde legs shog /lam du zhugs rnams bde legs shog /phyir 'od dag kyang bde legs shog /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shog /khyed cag kun tu bde legs shog /de dag sdig par ma gyur cig /nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin/ /rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che/ /dgra bcom thams cad zag pa med/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di rnams kyis/ /kun tu bde legs 'byunga'agyur cig /tad+ya thā/ ha ri ha ri ṇi ha ri ṇi tsa li tsa li ni tsa li ni bh+ra ma ṇi bh+ra ma ṇi/ mo ha ṇi sti bha ni/ dzam+bha ni swa yaṃ bhu be swāhā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srung pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig tad+ya thā/ su su ru su su ru su su ru su su ru me swāhā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa= nas/ mthong bar gyur cig gi bar gong bzhin/ tad+ya thā/ be lu gi be lu gi a mṛ ta ghā ta ni bā ru ṇa ba ti so ma ba ti ben+ṭa mā li ni be li ni be lu ne pu tri ke tso tsu tso tsu swāhā/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa= sogs gong bzhin/ tad+ya thā/ be du ri be du ri be du ri be du ri/ maṭ+ṭi te maṭ+ṭi te/

kau ṭi ko ṭi/ kau ṭi ko ṭi/ bid+yu ma ti bi d+yu ma ti/ hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu/ ru ru ru ru ru ru ru ru/ tsu tsu tsu tsu tsu tsu tsu tsu/ tsa tsa tsa tsa tsa tsa tsa tsa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa= sogs gong bzhin/ shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung*/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang*/ /byang phyogs na ni rnam thos bu/ /rgyal po chen po 'di bzhi dag /'jig rten skyong ba grangs dang ldan/ phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar byed/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ /pha rol dgra rnams rab tu 'joms/ / gzhan gyi mi thub thub par dka'/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ kha dog ldan zhing grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po lha min dang*/ /lha yi g.yul yang myong bar byed/ /khyed rnams kyis kyang bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srung bar mdzod cig /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs spyi dang mthun par 'phrin las bcol/ sngags re re'i mthar/ ar+ghaṃ sbyar te mchod yon phul/ dh+ri ta rāṣ+ta ya gats+tsha gats+tsha swa s+thā naṃ/ de bzhin du gzhan la'ang sbyar nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol du btang ngo*/ /'di la'ang phyogs gtor byed na so sor phral te bya/ de ltar na de dag ni/ gtor ma rnams mas rim nas gtong ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ /yang gtor ma'i rim pa rnams yas rim nas btang kyang*/ spyi 'gros kyi lag len dang mthun zhing mi legs pa ma yin pas ji ltar bde bas chog cing*/ de dag las ji ltar bde ba re re gnyis gnyis sogs de dang de bsgrub par bya'o/ / 'dir brjod pa dam tshig gsum bkod dpal ldan a ti sha /dbang phyug rin chen shākya rdo rje dang*/ / sangs rgyas 'bum dang mang mkhar lo tsā pa/ /gzhon nu 'od dang don ri grags chen pa/ /'di ni brgyud pa'i khyad par dang po yin/ kha che'i mkhas pa ye shes rdo rje dang*/ /pu rangs lo chung sa chen kun snying dang*/

/rje btsun grags rgyal nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ /nam mkha' bsod nams nub gog dar gzhon pa/ /ston pa don yod slob dpon rin rgyal ba/ /grags chen bla ma zhes pa'ang brgyud pa gzhan/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gzhon nu tshul khrims dang*/ /sngags 'chang tshul rgyal nam mkha' smon lam dang*/ /lo grags chos kyi rgyal mtshan ngag dbang grags/ /rnam rgyal grags pa tshul khrims mchog grub dang*/ /rnam rgyal bkra shis mkhan po rje btsun te/ /yang na rnam rin ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa 'di las byung ba yin/ /'di la lag len byed na bya rgyud kyi/ dkyil 'khor cho ga gang la'ang dka' ba med/ /yang smras pa/ 'di na rdo rje 'chang zhes grags pa 'gas/ /spyi rnam tsam gyi kha bshad bris med kyang*/ /kri ya'i cho ga phyogs mthong tsam yang min/ /sgrub thabs gcig la'ang lag len khel ba med/ /bya rgyud nub pas snying rlung langs so skad/ /mkhas chen 'ga' la ra mda' byas kyang bslus// zhes sogs yul dang ngag 'khyal rtag smra yang*/ /sum pa'i 'phrang gi rna ro'i dpe dang 'dra/ /chen po rnams kyang phal cher 'dres mar spyod/ /gong ma'i lugs su bkral na mi 'gal yang*/ /'dres ma'i lugs la gtsang mar 'dzin pa 'di/

/log shes yin phyir mkhas la mi mdzes so/ /dam tshig gsum bkod chog khrigs rab gsal ba/ /legs sbyar dge 'dis mtha' dag 'gro ba rnams/ /rab mchog dngos grub tshogs kyi dpal 'bar bas/ /shākya seṅge nyid dang mtshungs par shog /lha dang sngags dang cho ga ste/ 'da' bar mi bya dam tshig gsum/ sngags rigs kun gyi 'jug ngogs yin/ / 'di 'dra thob pa'ang skal ba bzang*/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bya ba'i rgyud mtha' dag la 'jug pa zhes bya ba 'di yang tā ra nā thas mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang sdig pa dang sdug bsngal ma lus pa zad pa'i lo la sbyar ba'o// // zhus dag/ bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bya ba'i rgyud mtha' dag la 'jug pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 154--PAGE 55--PAGE 54-
